context.en-US: Free radicals are reactive species bearing one or more unpaired electrons that are most often generated in biological systems as derivatives of oxygen (reactive oxygen species, ROS) or nitrogen (reactive nitrogen species, RNS). The unpaired electron makes them intrinsically unstable, driving them to abstract electrons from nearby molecules such as DNA, proteins, and lipids. This directionality, radicals attacking stable macromolecules, is the mechanistic basis of oxidative damage. A key caveat is that not all free radicals are harmful; at controlled low levels they serve as signaling intermediates, so the pathological state depends on concentration and antioxidant defense capacity.
context.zh-TW: Free radicals 是帶有一個或多個不成對電子的活性物質，通常在生物系統中作為氧（reactive oxygen species、ROS）或氮（reactive nitrogen species、RNS）的衍生物產生。不成對的電子使它們本質上不穩定，驅使它們從附近的分子（例如 DNA、proteins 和脂質）中奪取電子。這種自由基攻擊穩定大分子的方向性是氧化傷害的機制基礎。需要注意的是，並非所有 free radicals 都是有害的；在受控的低水平下，它們充當信號中間體，因此病理狀態取決於濃度和抗氧化防禦能力。

context.en-US: Free radicals initiate lipid peroxidation by abstracting a hydrogen atom from a bis-allylic methylene group of polyunsaturated fatty acids, creating a lipid radical that reacts with molecular oxygen to form a peroxyl radical. The peroxyl radical then abstracts hydrogen from an adjacent lipid, propagating a self-amplifying chain reaction in which a single radical can oxidize many lipid molecules before termination. This chain chemistry explains why lipid peroxidation spreads rapidly within membranes once initiated. The biological significance is substantial because the reaction compromises membrane integrity and yields reactive aldehyde byproducts such as malondialdehyde and 4-HNE.
context.zh-TW: Free radicals 透過從 polyunsaturated fatty acids 的雙烯丙基亞甲基中提取氫原子來引發 lipid peroxidation，產生脂質自由基，該脂質自由基與分子氧反應形成過氧自由基。然後，過氧自由基從相鄰的脂質中提取氫，傳播自放大的鍊式反應，其中單個自由基可以在終止之前氧化許多脂質分子。這種鍊式化學反應解釋了為什麼 lipid peroxidation 一旦啟動就會在膜內迅速傳播。生物學意義重大，因為此反應會損害膜完整性並產生反應性醛副產物，例如 malondialdehyde 和 4-HNE。

context.en-US: Free radicals damage DNA primarily through the generation of oxidatively modified bases and strand breaks, with 8-oxo-2'-deoxyguanosine and single-strand breaks being the most characteristic lesions. Hydroxyl radicals and other highly reactive species attack the C8 position of guanine and can cleave the sugar-phosphate backbone directly. The directionality is from radical to nucleic acid, and the damage is largely one-directional unless repaired. A caveat is that cells possess robust base-excision repair and sanitizing enzymes (OGG1, MTH1) that limit mutation, so measurable damage reflects the balance between insult and repair rather than instantaneous radical flux.
context.zh-TW: Free radicals 主要透過氧化修飾鹼基的生成和鏈斷裂來損傷 DNA，其中 8-oxo-2'-deoxyguanosine 和單鏈斷裂是最具特徵性的損傷。 Hydroxyl radicals和其他高活性物質攻擊鳥嘌呤的C8位置，可以直接裂解糖-磷酸主鏈。方向性是從自由基到核酸，除非修復，否則損傷很大程度上是單向的。需要注意的是，細胞擁有強大的鹼​​基切除修復和淨化酵素（OGG1、MTH1）來限制突變，因此可測量的損傷反映了損傷和修復之間的平衡，而不是瞬時自由基通量。

context.en-US: Free radicals contribute to atherosclerosis by oxidizing low-density lipoprotein (LDL) within the arterial intima, an event widely considered rate-limiting for foam-cell formation and plaque initiation. Oxidized LDL is no longer recognized by the native LDL receptor but is avidly taken up by macrophage scavenger receptors such as CD36, driving foam-cell accumulation. The causal direction runs from radical-mediated oxidation to retention and innate immune recognition of LDL in the vessel wall. A caveat is that oxidation is one of several parallel mechanisms (e.g., endothelial dysfunction, inflammation) and that not all oxidized LDL is equally atherogenic.
context.zh-TW: Free radicals 透過氧化動脈內膜內的低密度脂蛋白 (LDL) 來促進 atherosclerosis，這一事件被廣泛認為是泡沫細胞形成和斑塊起始的限速事件。 Oxidized LDL 不再被天然 LDL 受體識別，而是被巨噬細胞清道夫受體（例如 CD36）大量吸收，驅動泡沫細胞積聚。因果方向從自由基介導的氧化到血管壁中 LDL 的保留和先天免疫識別。需要注意的是，氧化是幾種並行機制（例如 endothelial dysfunction、發炎）之一，並非所有 oxidized LDL 都同樣會導致動脈粥狀硬化。

context.en-US: Free radicals are neutralized by antioxidants, which terminate radical chain reactions by donating an electron or hydrogen atom without becoming damaging radicals themselves. Chain-breaking antioxidants such as vitamin E and vitamin C intercept lipid peroxyl radicals and regenerate one another in the hydrophilic and lipophilic phases, respectively. The relationship is stoichiometric and bidirectional in the sense that antioxidants are consumed as they protect, requiring continuous resynthesis. A caveat is that antioxidant supplementation does not always recapitulate endogenous protection and can be ineffective or even adverse at high doses due to pro-oxidant or hormetic effects.
context.zh-TW: Free radicals 被 antioxidants 中和，antioxidants 透過提供電子或氫原子來終止自由基鍊式反應，而不會成為 damaging 自由基本身。 vitamin E 和維生素 C 等斷鍊 antioxidants 會攔截脂質過氧化自由基，並分別在親水相和親脂相中相互再生。這種關係是化學計量和雙向的，因為 antioxidants 在保護時被消耗，需要不斷的重新合成。需要注意的是，抗氧化劑補充劑並不總是能再現內源性保護作用，並且由於促氧化劑或毒物興奮作用，高劑量時可能無效甚至有害。

context.en-US: Superoxide radical (O2-*) is the prototypical reactive oxygen species, formed by the addition of a single electron to ground-state molecular oxygen. It is the primary, upstream ROS from which hydrogen peroxide and peroxynitrite are derived through dismutation and radical-radical reactions. Its directionality is as a precursor rather than a terminal effector, and it is relatively unreactive toward most biomolecules compared with downstream species. A caveat is that its major toxicity often arises indirectly through conversion to more reactive products (H2O2, hydroxyl radical, peroxynitrite) rather than from superoxide itself.
context.zh-TW: 超氧自由基 (O2-*) 是典型的 reactive oxygen species，是透過向基態分子氧添加單一電子而形成的。它是主要的上游ROS，透過歧化和自由基-自由基反應衍生出hydrogen peroxide和peroxynitrite。它的方向性是作為前體而不是末端效應器，與下游物種相比，它對大多數生物分子的反應性相對較低。需要注意的是，其主要毒性通常是透過轉化為更具反應性的產物（H2O2、羥基自由基、peroxynitrite）而非超氧化物本身間接產生的。

context.en-US: Superoxide radicals are produced by mitochondria as an inevitable byproduct of electron transport, chiefly at Complex I and Complex III where electrons leak onto molecular oxygen. Roughly 0.1 to 2 percent of consumed oxygen is estimated to form superoxide at these sites, making mitochondria the largest endogenous source of ROS. The directionality is from electron leakage to radical generation, which is then opposed by manganese superoxide dismutase in the matrix. A caveat is that mitochondrial superoxide is both a damaging agent and a tuned signal for mitohormesis and retrograde communication at low levels.
context.zh-TW: Superoxide radicals 是 mitochondria 產生的，作為電子傳輸不可避免的副產品，主要在複合物 I 和複合物 III 中，電子洩漏到分子氧上。據估計，大約 0.1% 至 2% 的消耗氧氣會在這些位點形成超氧化物，使 mitochondria 成為 ROS 的最大內源來源。方向性是從電子洩漏到自由基生成，然後與基體中的錳superoxide dismutase相反。需要注意的是，mitochondria1超氧化物既是 damaging 劑，也是 mitohormesis 和低水平逆行通訊的調諧訊號。

context.en-US: Superoxide radicals are produced by NADPH oxidase (NOX) enzymes, which are dedicated ROS-generating enzymes that transfer electrons from cytosolic NADPH across the membrane to molecular oxygen. In phagocytes this serves host defense, whereas in non-phagocytic cells NOX isoforms generate superoxide for redox signaling, vascular tone regulation, and growth control. The causal direction is enzyme-catalyzed and inducible, distinguishing NOX from incidental mitochondrial leak. A caveat is that pathological NOX activation (e.g., by angiotensin II) sustains oxidative stress implicated in cardiovascular and metabolic disease.
context.zh-TW: Superoxide radicals 由 NADPH oxidase (NOX) 酶產生，這些酶是專門生成 ROS 的酶，可將電子從胞質 NADPH acros 轉移到膜上的分子氧。在 phagocytes 中，這有助於宿主防禦，而在非吞噬細胞中，NOX 同工型會產生超氧化物，用於氧化還原訊號傳導、血管張力調節和生長控制。因果方向是酶催化和誘導的，將 NOX 與偶然的 mitochondria1 洩漏區分開來。需要注意的是，病理性 NOX 活化（例如透過 angiotensin II）會維持與心血管和代謝疾病有關的 oxidative stress。

context.en-US: Superoxide dismutase (SOD) catalyzes the dismutation of two superoxide radicals into hydrogen peroxide and oxygen, accelerating a reaction that is already spontaneous to near diffusion-limited rates. Three isoforms partition the task: Cu/Zn-SOD in cytosol and extracellular space, Mn-SOD in mitochondria, and extracellular SOD in the interstitium. The directionality is detoxification of a precursor radical into a more diffusible but less reactive species. A caveat is that the H2O2 product still requires removal by catalase or glutathione peroxidase, so SOD activity shifts rather than eliminates oxidative burden.
context.zh-TW: Superoxide dismutase (SOD) 催化兩個 superoxide radicals 歧化為 hydrogen peroxide 和氧氣，將已經自發的反應加速到接近擴散極限的速率。三種異構體分工：細胞質和細胞外空間的 Cu/Zn-SOD、mitochondria 中的 Mn-SOD 以及間質中的細胞外 SOD。方向性是將前驅自由基解毒成更易擴散但反應性較低的物質。需要注意的是，H2O2 產物仍需要透過 catalase 或 glutathione peroxidase 去除，因此 SOD 活性會發生變化，而不是消除氧化負擔。

context.en-US: Superoxide radicals react with nitric oxide (NO) at a near diffusion-limited rate (k approximately 1.6 x 10^10 M-1 s-1) to form peroxynitrite, outcompeting superoxide dismutase for NO under many conditions. This radical-radical combination couples two signaling systems and converts a beneficial vasodilator into a potent oxidant and nitrating species. The relationship is non-enzymatic, and it both consumes NO and generates peroxynitrite. A caveat is that the outcome depends on local concentration and compartmentalization, with physiological NO signaling preserved when superoxide is low.
context.zh-TW: Superoxide radicals 與 nitric oxide (NO) 以接近擴散極限的速率（k 約為 1.6 x 10^10 M-1 s-1）反應形成 peroxynitrite，在許多條件下擊敗 superoxide dismutase 爭奪 NO。這種自由基-自由基的組合將兩個訊號系統結合起來，並將有益的血管擴張劑轉化為有效的氧化劑和硝化物質。這個關係是非酵素的，它既消耗NO又產生peroxynitrite。需要注意的是，結果取決於局部濃度和區室化，當超氧化物水平較低時，生理性 NO 訊號會保留。

context.en-US: Superoxide radicals form hydrogen peroxide through spontaneous and enzymatic dismutation, in which two superoxide molecules are converted to H2O2 and O2. Because H2O2 is membrane-permeable and relatively long-lived, it serves as the diffusible messenger downstream of superoxide. The directionality is precursor-to-product in the canonical ROS cascade. A caveat is that H2O2 is far less reactive than superoxide's downstream products, yet its accumulation is dangerous because transition metals convert it to the extremely reactive hydroxyl radical via Fenton chemistry.
context.zh-TW: Superoxide radicals 透過自發性和酶促歧化形成 hydrogen peroxide，其中兩個超氧化物分子轉化為 H2O2 和 O2。由於 H2O2 具有膜滲透性且壽命相對較長，因此它可作為超氧化物下游的擴散信使。在典型的 ROS 級聯中，方向性是前驅物到產物。需要注意的是，H2O2 的反應性遠低於超氧化物下游產物，但它的累積是危險的，因為過渡金屬透過芬頓化學將其轉化為極具反應性的羥基自由基。

context.en-US: Superoxide radicals form peroxynitrite upon reaction with nitric oxide, producing a powerful oxidant and nitrating agent (ONOO-). This species is the key molecular bridge between oxidative and nitrative stress pathways. The directionality flows from two radicals to a single, more damaging hybrid molecule. A caveat is that peroxynitrite exists in equilibrium with its conjugate acid and decomposes to secondary radicals, so its biological effects are context- and pH-dependent. This union is among the fastest known reactions and outcompetes superoxide dismutase for superoxide, so peroxynitrite builds up readily in inflamed or reperfused tissue.
context.zh-TW: Superoxide radicals 與 nitric oxide 反應形成 peroxynitrite，產生強氧化劑和硝化劑（ONOO-）。該物種是氧化途徑和 nitrative stress 途徑之間的關鍵分子橋樑。方向性從兩個自由基流向一個更 damaging 混合分子。需要注意的是，peroxynitrite 與其共軛酸處於平衡狀態，並分解為次級自由基，因此其生物效應取決於環境和 pH 值。這種結合是已知最快的反應之一，並且在超氧化物方面勝過 superoxide dismutase，因此 peroxynitrite 很容易在發炎或再灌注的組織中累積。

context.en-US: Superoxide radicals contribute to cardiovascular disease when produced in the vascular wall by NOX enzymes, where they rapidly consume nitric oxide and thereby impair endothelium-dependent vasodilation. The resulting NO deficiency promotes vasoconstriction, platelet activation, and a pro-atherogenic endothelial phenotype. The causal direction runs from vascular superoxide to nitric-oxide depletion and dysfunction. A caveat is that not all vascular superoxide is pathological; transient bursts participate in normal signaling, and the disease state reflects chronic, unresolved production.
context.zh-TW: 當 NOX 酶在血管壁中產生 Superoxide radicals 時，它們會快速消耗 nitric oxide，從而損害內皮依賴性 vasodilation。由此產生的 NO 缺乏會促進血管收縮、血小板活化和促動脈粥狀硬化內皮表型。因果方向從血管超氧化物到一氧化氮消耗和功能障礙。需要注意的是，並非所有血管超氧化物都是病理性的。短暫的爆發參與正常的訊號傳導，而疾病狀態則反映了慢性的、未解決的生產。

context.en-US: Hydroxyl radicals (OH*) are the most reactive and indiscriminately damaging members of the reactive oxygen species family, reacting at near diffusion-limited rates with almost every class of biomolecule. They are not stored or transported but arise locally and instantaneously from hydrogen peroxide via Fenton or Haber-Weiss chemistry in the presence of reduced transition metals. Their directionality is terminal and destructive; they cannot be enzymatically scavenged once formed because they react before diffusing. A caveat is that their extreme reactivity means damage is confined to the site of generation, implicating metal localization as the critical determinant of target selectivity.
context.zh-TW: Hydroxyl radicals (OH*) 是 reactive oxygen species 家族中反應性最強且不加區別的 damaging 成員，幾乎與每一類生物分子都以接近擴散極限的速率發生反應。它們不會被儲存或運輸，而是在還原的過渡金屬存在下透過芬頓或哈伯-韋斯化學從 hydrogen peroxide 本地即時產生。它們的方向性是終極的、具破壞性的；它們一旦形成就不能被酵素清除，因為它們在擴散之前發生反應。需要注意的是，它們的極端反應性意味著損傷僅限於產生部位，這意味著金屬定位是目標選擇性的關鍵決定因素。

context.en-US: Hydroxyl radicals are formed from hydrogen peroxide through the Fenton reaction, in which Fe2+ (or Cu+) reduces H2O2 to OH* while being oxidized to Fe3+. This metal-dependent chemistry explains why intracellular free iron is tightly sequestered by ferritin and transferrin. The directionality is from a relatively stable oxidant to the most reactive radical. A caveat is that H2O2 is not intrinsically harmful in the absence of free redox-active metal, so iron availability gates hydroxyl-radical formation.
context.zh-TW: Hydroxyl radicals由hydrogen peroxide透過Fenton reaction形成，其中Fe2+（或Cu+）將H2O2還原為OH*，同時被氧化為Fe3+。這種金屬依賴性化學反應解釋了為什麼細胞內 free iron 被 ferritin 和轉鐵蛋白緊密隔離。方向性是從相對穩定的氧化劑到最具反應性的自由基。需要注意的是，在沒有遊離氧化還原活性金屬的情況下，H2O2 本質上並不有害，因此 iron 的可用性會阻止羥基自由基的形成。

context.en-US: The Fenton reaction produces hydroxyl radicals according to Fe2+ + H2O2 to Fe3+ + OH* + OH-, a one-electron reduction of hydrogen peroxide by ferrous iron. This reaction is the principal mechanism by which relatively inert H2O2 is converted into the supremely reactive hydroxyl radical at sites of free iron. The directionality is metal-catalyzed conversion of a diffusible oxidant into a locally devastating radical. A caveat is that the ferric product can be recycled back to Fe2+ by reductants, sustaining chain production of hydroxyl radicals as long as iron and peroxide coexist.
context.zh-TW: Fenton reaction 根據 Fe2+ + H2O2 產生 hydroxyl radicals 至 Fe3+ + OH* + OH-，這是亞鐵 iron 對 hydrogen peroxide 的單電子還原。此反應是相對惰性的 H2O2 在 free iron 位點轉化為活性極高的羥基自由基的主要機制。方向性是擴散氧化劑在金屬催化下轉化為局部破壞性自由基。需要注意的是，只要 iron 和過氧化物共存，三價鐵產品就可以透過還原劑回收 Fe2+，從而維持 hydroxyl radicals 的鍊式生產。

context.en-US: Hydroxyl radicals cause DNA damage by abstracting hydrogen from the sugar-phosphate backbone, yielding strand breaks, and by adding to bases such as guanine to form 8-oxo-2'-deoxyguanosine. Because they react at the site of generation, damage is tightly localized to where iron and H2O2 coincide, including chromatin-bound iron. The directionality is direct and irreversible without repair. A caveat is that many such lesions are normally repaired efficiently by base-excision repair, so pathology emerges only when damage rate exceeds repair capacity.
context.zh-TW: Hydroxyl radicals 透過從糖-磷酸主鏈中提取氫，產生鏈斷裂，並透過添加鹼基（例如鳥嘌呤）形成 8-oxo-2'-deoxyguanosine 來產生 DNA damage。因為它們在生成位點發生反應，所以損傷緊密位於 iron 和 H2O2 重合的位置，包括染色質結合的 iron。方向性是直接的，不可逆，無需修復。需要注意的是，許多此類損傷通常可以透過鹼基切除修復有效修復，因此只有當損傷率超過修復能力時才會出現病理。

context.en-US: Hydroxyl radicals initiate lipid peroxidation by abstracting a hydrogen atom from the bis-allylic methylene of polyunsaturated fatty acids, seeding the radical chain that destroys cell membranes. Once a lipid radical forms, propagation proceeds autocatalytically even after the initiating hydroxyl radical is gone. The directionality is from a locally generated radical to rapid, spreading membrane damage. A caveat is that membrane vitamin E and CoQ10 can terminate the chain, so outcome depends on the local antioxidant milieu.
context.zh-TW: Hydroxyl radicals 透過從 polyunsaturated fatty acids 的雙烯丙基亞甲基中提取一個氫原子來啟動 lipid peroxidation，播下破壞細胞膜的自由基鏈。一旦脂質自由基形成，即使在引發的羥基自由基消失後，傳播也會自動進行。方向性是從局部產生的自由基到快速擴散的膜損傷。需要注意的是，膜 vitamin E 和 CoQ10 可以終止該鏈，因此結果取決於局部抗氧化環境。

context.en-US: Hydroxyl radicals cause protein carbonylation, an irreversible oxidative modification introduced when the radical attacks susceptible amino-acid side chains (notably Lys, Arg, Pro, Thr) or when lipid-peroxidation products adduct to proteins. Carbonylated proteins lose function and are targeted for degradation by the 20S proteasome. The directionality is from radical insult to stable, diagnostically useful protein modification. A caveat is that carbonylation is a downstream and cumulative marker rather than an acute, quantitative readout of hydroxyl-radical flux.
context.zh-TW: Hydroxyl radicals 導致 protein carbonylation，這是一種不可逆的氧化修飾，當自由基攻擊易受影響的氨基酸側鏈（特別是 Lys、Arg、Pro、Thr）或脂質過氧化產物加成 proteins 時引入。 Carbonylated proteins 失去功能，成為 20S proteasome 降級的目標。方向性是從徹底的損傷到穩定的、診斷上有用的蛋白質修飾。需要注意的是，羰基化是下游和累積標記，而不是羥基自由基通量的精確定量讀數。

context.en-US: Hydroxyl radicals contribute to neurodegenerative diseases because redox-active iron accumulates in vulnerable regions such as the substantia nigra, where Fenton chemistry generates hydroxyl radicals locally. This regional iron burden correlates with oxidative damage to dopaminergic neurons and alpha-synuclein nitration and aggregation. The directionality is metal-catalyzed radical formation driving neuronal injury. A caveat is that oxidative damage is one component of a multifactorial degenerative process and may be downstream of protein misfolding and mitochondrial failure rather than solely initiating them.
context.zh-TW: Hydroxyl radicals 對 neurodegenerative diseases 有貢獻，因為氧化還原活性 iron 積聚在黑質等脆弱區域，芬頓化學在黑質中局部生成 hydroxyl radicals。這種區域性 iron 負擔與 dopaminergic 神經元的氧化損傷以及 alpha-synuclein 硝化和聚集有關。方向性是金屬催化的自由基形成驅動神經元損傷。需要注意的是，氧化損傷是多因素退化過程的一個組成部分，並且可能是蛋白質錯誤折疊和 mitochondria1 失敗的下游，而不是僅僅引發它們。

context.en-US: Singlet oxygen (1O2) is an electronically excited, non-radical state of molecular oxygen generated by photosensitization or during leukocyte killing. Although not a free radical, it is classified among reactive oxygen species because of its high energy and reactivity toward unsaturated lipids and nucleobases. The directionality is from energy absorption to direct oxidation without chain initiation. A caveat is that singlet oxygen is quenched very efficiently by carotenoids and alpha-tocopherol, so its range is extremely short.
context.zh-TW: Singlet oxygen (1O2) 是光敏作用或白血球殺傷過程中產生的電子激發的非自由基狀態的分子氧。雖然不是自由基，但由於其高能量以及對不飽和脂質和核鹼基的反應性，它被歸類為 reactive oxygen species。方向性是從能量吸收到沒有鏈引發的直接氧化。需要注意的是，singlet oxygen 可以被類胡蘿蔔素和 α-生育醇非常有效地猝滅，因此它的作用範圍極短。

context.en-US: Singlet oxygen causes lipid peroxidation by directly oxidizing cholesterol and polyunsaturated fatty acids through ene reactions that form hydroperoxides without requiring a free-radical initiation step. This non-chain mechanism nevertheless seeds downstream radical chain reactions once lipid hydroperoxides decompose. The directionality is from excited oxygen to membrane oxidation. A caveat is that singlet oxygen's short lifetime limits damage to the immediate vicinity of its photosensitized generation, such as sun-exposed skin.
context.zh-TW: Singlet oxygen 透過形成氫過氧化物的烯反應直接氧化 cholesterol 和 polyunsaturated fatty acids，從而產生 lipid peroxidation，無需自由基引發步驟。然而，一旦脂質氫過氧化物分解，這種非鏈機制就會引發下游自由基鏈反應。方向性是從激發氧到膜氧化。需要注意的是，singlet oxygen 的壽命較短，限制了對其光敏代附近區域的損害，例如暴露在陽光下的皮膚。

context.en-US: Singlet oxygen causes DNA damage by reacting with guanine at the C8 position to produce 8-oxo-2'-deoxyguanosine and related mutagenic lesions. Its reactivity is highly selective for guanine among the bases, making 8-oxodG the signature oxidative DNA adduct. The directionality is photochemical or oxidative modification of nucleobases. A caveat is that, like other oxidative lesions, these are normally repaired by OGG1-mediated base-excision repair, so persistence indicates failed repair rather than mere exposure.
context.zh-TW: Singlet oxygen 透過與 C8 位的鳥嘌呤反應產生 8-oxo-2'-deoxyguanosine 和相關的誘變損傷，從而引起 DNA damage。其反應活性對鹼基中的鳥嘌呤具有高度選擇性，使 8-oxodG 成為標誌性氧化 DNA 加成物。方向性是核鹼基的光化學或氧化修飾。需要注意的是，與其他氧化損傷一樣，這些損傷通常是透過 OGG1 介導的鹼基切除修復來修復的，因此持續存在表明修復失敗而不僅僅是暴露。

context.en-US: Vitamin E (alpha-tocopherol) quenches singlet oxygen by physical quenching, transferring the excited oxygen's energy to the tocopherol, which then dissipates it as heat without being consumed in a single act. This occurs at high rate constants within the lipid phase where vitamin E is embedded in membranes. The directionality is protective and stoichiometric but recyclable. A caveat is that chemical quenching can also consume tocopherol, requiring regeneration by vitamin C and CoQ10 to sustain the protective effect.
context.zh-TW: Vitamin E（α-生育酚）透過物理猝滅來猝滅 singlet oxygen，將激發態氧的能量傳遞給生育酚，然後生育酚將其以熱量形式消散，而不是一次性消耗。這在 vitamin E 嵌入膜的脂質相內以高速率常數發生。方向性是保護性的和化學計量的，但可回收。要注意的是，化學猝滅也會消耗生育酚，需要維生素 C 和 CoQ10 再生才能維持保護作用。

context.en-US: Singlet oxygen mediates UV-induced photoaging because UVA radiation excites endogenous photosensitizers (e.g., porphyrins, flavins) in skin, producing 1O2 that induces matrix metalloproteinase (MMP) expression. MMPs degrade collagen and elastin, producing wrinkles, laxity, and solar elastosis. The directionality is photon to radical to enzyme to matrix destruction. A caveat is that UVA also generates other ROS and activates signaling pathways independently, so singlet oxygen is one contributor among several in photoaging.
context.zh-TW: Singlet oxygen 介導 UV-induced photoaging，因為 UVA 輻射會激發皮膚中的內源性光敏劑（例如卟啉、黃素），產生 1O2，誘導基質金屬蛋白酶 (MMP) 表現。 MMP 會降解膠原蛋白和彈性蛋白，產生皺紋、鬆弛和日光性彈性組織變性。方向性是光子到自由基到酵素到基質破壞。需要注意的是，UVA 也會產生其他 ROS 並獨立活化訊號通路，因此 singlet oxygen 是 photoaging 中的幾個貢獻者之一。

context.en-US: Catalase decomposes hydrogen peroxide to water and oxygen with an extraordinarily high catalytic rate (kcat approximately 10^7 s-1 per tetramer), making it the fastest H2O2-removing enzyme. It uses a heme prosthetic group that cycles through Compound I and Compound II intermediates during turnover. The directionality is detoxification of a diffusible oxidant into harmless products. A caveat is that catalase has a relatively high Km for H2O2 and thus complements, rather than substitutes for, the higher-affinity glutathione peroxidase system at low peroxide concentrations.
context.zh-TW: Catalase 以極高的催化速率（kcat 約為每個四聚體 10^7 s-1）將 hydrogen peroxide 分解為水和氧氣，使其成為最快的 H2O2 去除酵素。它使用血紅素 prosthetic 基團，在周轉期間循環通過化合物 I 和化合物 II 中間體。方向性是將可擴散氧化劑解毒成無害產物。需要注意的是，catalase 對 H2O2 具有相對較高的 Km，因此在低過氧化物濃度下補充而不是取代更高親和力的 glutathione peroxidase 系統。

context.en-US: Catalase protects against oxidative stress by eliminating hydrogen peroxide before it can be converted by transition metals into the damaging hydroxyl radical. Its peroxisomal localization places it near H2O2-generating oxidases, intercepting peroxide at source. The directionality is preventive detoxification upstream of Fenton chemistry. A caveat is that catalase alone cannot handle the full cellular H2O2 burden, so its protective role is shared with glutathione peroxidase and peroxiredoxins. Because it requires no cofactors and works at very high catalytic rates, catalase is especially effective at clearing the large peroxide bursts produced during infection and ischemia-reperfusion.
context.zh-TW: Catalase 透過在 hydrogen peroxide 被過渡金屬轉化為 damaging 羥基自由基之前消除 oxidative stress 來防止 oxidative stress。它的過氧化物酶體定位使其靠近產生 H2O2 的氧化酶，從源頭攔截過氧化物。方向性是芬頓化學上游的預防性解毒。需要注意的是，catalase 本身無法處理全部細胞 H2O2 負擔，因此其保護作用與 glutathione peroxidase 和過氧化還原蛋白共享。由於 catalase 不需要輔因子且催化速率非常高，因此它在清除感染和缺血再灌注過程中產生的大量過氧化物特別有效。

context.en-US: Catalase is localized predominantly in peroxisomes, organelles that host numerous H2O2-generating oxidases involved in lipid beta-oxidation and purine catabolism. Concentrating catalase here minimizes leakage of peroxide into the cytosol and nucleus. The directionality reflects compartmentalization of both source and sink of H2O2. A caveat is that a minority of catalase activity also exists in cytosol and mitochondria in some tissues, providing additional but lesser protection. This compartmentalization is functionally important: peroxisomal beta-oxidation of very-long-chain fatty acids generates substantial H2O2, and catalase prevents that peroxide from spilling into the cytosol.
context.zh-TW: Catalase 主要位於 peroxisomes 細胞器中，該細胞器含有大量參與脂質 β 氧化和嘌呤分解代謝的產生 H2O2 的氧化酶。在此濃縮 catalase 可最大程度地減少過氧化物洩漏到細胞質和細胞核。方向性反映了 H2O2 源和彙的劃分。需要注意的是，少數 catalase 活性也存在於某些組織的細胞質和 mitochondria 中，提供額外但較少的保護。這種區室化在功能上很重要：極長鏈脂肪酸的過氧化物酶體 β 氧化會產生大量 H2O2，而 catalase 可以防止過氧化物溢出到細胞質中。

subject: Catalase deficiency

context.en-US: Catalase deficiency causes acatalasemia (Takahara's disease), a rare autosomal recessive disorder in which near-absent catalase activity leads to oral mucosal ulcers and periodontal destruction from accumulated H2O2. The pathology arises because bacterial metabolism in the mouth produces H2O2 that cannot be degraded, fostering gangrene-prone infections. The directionality is enzyme loss to local oxidative injury. A caveat is that many acatalasemic individuals are surprisingly asymptomatic, indicating redundancy from other peroxide-removing systems.
context.zh-TW: Catalase deficiency 會導致 acatalasemia（高原氏症），這是一種罕見的體染色體隱性遺傳疾病，幾乎不存在 catalase 活性，導致口腔黏膜潰瘍和累積的 H2O2 造成牙周破壞。這種病理現象的產生是因為口腔中的細菌代謝產生無法降解的 H2O2，促進壞疽感染。方向性是酵素損失導致局部氧化損傷。需要注意的是，許多 acatalasemic 個體出乎意料地沒有症狀，這表明其他過氧化物去除系統存在冗餘。

subject: Catalase downregulation

context.en-US: Catalase downregulation contributes to cancer because reduced H2O2 clearance permits sustained oxidative stress that can drive DNA damage, genomic instability, and altered redox signaling favoring proliferation. Catalase is frequently downregulated in breast, prostate, and hepatocellular carcinomas relative to normal tissue. The directionality is loss-of-defense promoting tumorigenic oxidative damage. A caveat is that many tumors also exploit moderate ROS for survival signaling, so catalase levels represent a context-dependent balance rather than a simple tumor suppressor.
context.zh-TW: Catalase downregulation 有助於 cancer，因為減少的 H2O2 清除允許持續的 oxidative stress，從而驅動 DNA damage、基因組不穩定性和有利於增殖的氧化還原訊號傳導改變。相對於正常組織，Catalase 在乳癌、prostate 和肝細胞癌中經常下調。方向性是防禦喪失促進致瘤性氧化損傷。需要注意的是，許多腫瘤也利用適度的 ROS 來發出生存訊號，因此 catalase 水平代表了情境依賴性平衡，而不是簡單的腫瘤抑制因子。

context.en-US: Mitochondrial catalase overexpression extends lifespan, as demonstrated by MCAT (mitochondrial catalase transgenic) mice showing roughly 20 percent increased median lifespan and delayed age-related pathology. By concentrating catalase in the mitochondrial matrix, H2O2 from Complex I or III leak is removed before it propagates damage. The directionality is targeted detoxification promoting longevity. A caveat is that lifespan extension is modest and tissue-specific, and overexpression does not abolish all aging phenotypes, indicating multiple parallel aging mechanisms.
context.zh-TW: Mitochondrial catalase overexpression延長了壽命，正如MCAT（mitochondria1catalase轉基因）小鼠所證明的那樣，其顯示中位壽命延長了約20％並延遲了與年齡相關的病理。透過將catalase濃縮在mitochondria1基質中，來自複合物I或III洩漏的H 2 O 2 在其傳播損害之前被除去。方向性是針對性排毒延年益壽。需要注意的是，壽命延長是適度的且具有組織特異性，且過度表現並不能消除所有 aging 表型，表明存在多個並行的 aging 機制。

context.en-US: Glutathione peroxidase reduces hydrogen peroxide to water using reduced glutathione (GSH) as the electron donor, oxidizing two GSH molecules to glutathione disulfide (GSSG) per H2O2. This selenium-dependent enzyme thus couples peroxide removal to the cellular thiol redox buffer. The directionality is peroxide to water with coordinated thiol oxidation. A caveat is that GPx activity depends on GSH recycling by glutathione reductase and NADPH, so its capacity is gated by cellular redox and energy status.
context.zh-TW: Glutathione peroxidase 使用還原的 glutathione (GSH) 作為電子供體將 hydrogen peroxide 還原為水，每個 H2O2 將兩個 GSH 分子氧化為 glutathione 二硫化物 (GSSG)。因此，這種 selenium 依賴性酶將過氧化物去除與細胞硫醇氧化還原緩衝液耦合。方向性是過氧化物到水並協調硫醇氧化。需要注意的是，GPx 活性取決於 glutathione 還原酶和 NADPH 的 GSH 回收，因此其容量受到細胞氧化還原和能量狀態的控制。

context.en-US: Glutathione peroxidase requires selenium in the form of a catalytic selenocysteine residue at its active site, which is essential for the redox chemistry of peroxide reduction. Dietary selenium deficiency lowers GPx activity and leaves cells more vulnerable to oxidative injury. The directionality is nutrient to enzyme function. A caveat is that excess selenium is toxic and does not further increase activity, so there is a narrow optimal range for antioxidant benefit. Selenocysteine is incorporated into GPx during translation at a recoded UGA codon, and selenium status tracks circulating GPx activity closely, making the enzyme a sensitive functional marker of selenium nutrition.
context.zh-TW: Glutathione peroxidase 需要 selenium 在其活性位點以催化硒半胱氨酸殘基的形式存在，這對於過氧化物還原的氧化還原化學至關重要。飲食中的 selenium deficiency 會降低 GPx 活性，使細胞更容易受到氧化損傷。方向性是營養物質對酵素功能的影響。需要注意的是，過量的 selenium 是有毒的，並且不會進一步增加活性，因此抗氧化功效的最佳範圍很窄。硒代半胱氨酸在翻譯過程中在重新編碼的 UGA 密碼子處摻入 GPx，並且 selenium 狀態密切追蹤循環 GPx 活性，使該酶成為 selenium 營養的敏感功能標記。

context.en-US: Glutathione is the reducing cofactor for glutathione peroxidase, being oxidized from GSH to GSSG during the catalytic reduction of hydrogen peroxide and lipid hydroperoxides. Maintenance of a high GSH/GSSG ratio is therefore critical for sustained peroxidase activity and overall redox buffering. The directionality is cofactor consumption driving the antioxidant cycle. A caveat is that glutathione also serves many other roles (conjugation, thiol buffering, immune function), so its depletion has effects beyond peroxidase support.
context.zh-TW: Glutathione 是 glutathione peroxidase 的還原輔助因子，在 hydrogen peroxide 和脂質氫過氧化物的催化還原過程中從 GSH 氧化為 GSSG。因此，維持高 GSH/GSSG 比率對於持續的過氧化物酶活性和整體氧化還原緩衝至關重要。方向性是驅動抗氧化劑循環的輔因子消耗。需要注意的是，glutathione 還具有許多其他作用（結合、硫醇緩衝、免疫功能），因此它的耗盡具有過氧化物酶支持以外的影響。

context.en-US: Glutathione peroxidase is complementary to catalase because the two enzymes remove hydrogen peroxide with different kinetic profiles: GPx has higher affinity (Km approximately 1 to 10 uM) suited to low physiological H2O2, whereas catalase has a higher Vmax suited to burst conditions. Together they cover the dynamic range of intracellular peroxide concentrations. The directionality is cooperative detoxification rather than redundancy alone. A caveat is that peroxiredoxins now appear to handle much of the low-level H2O2 signaling pool, with GPx and catalase managing bulk removal.
context.zh-TW: Glutathione peroxidase 與 catalase 互補，因為這兩種酶以不同的動力學曲線去除 hydrogen peroxide：GPx 具有適合低生理 H2O2 的更高親和力（Km 大約 1 至 10 uM），而 catalase 具有適合突發條件的更高 Vmax。它們共同涵蓋了細胞內過氧化物濃度的動態範圍。方向性是合作解毒，而不是單純的冗餘。需要注意的是，過氧化還原蛋白現在似乎可以處理大部分低水平的 H2O2 訊號池，其中 GPx 和 catalase managing 被大量去除。

context.en-US: GPx4 protects against ferroptosis as the master negative regulator of this iron-dependent, lipid-peroxidation-driven cell death. By reducing phospholipid hydroperoxides in membranes using GSH, GPx4 prevents the lethal accumulation of oxidized phosphatidylethanolamines. The directionality is enzymatic reduction preventing membrane collapse. A caveat is that GPx4 activity is exquisitely GSH-dependent, so anything depleting GSH (e.g., system xc- inhibition by erastin) triggers ferroptosis even with GPx4 present.
context.zh-TW: GPx4 作為此 iron 依賴性、脂質過氧化驅動的細胞死亡的主要負調節因子，可防止 ferroptosis。透過使用 GSH 減少膜中的磷脂氫過氧化物，GPx4 可以防止氧化磷脂酰乙醇胺的致命積累。方向性是酵素還原，防止膜塌陷。需要注意的是，GPx4 活性完全依賴 GSH，因此任何消耗 GSH 的因素（例如，erastin 抑制系統 xc）都會觸發 ferroptosis，即使存在 GPx4。

context.en-US: Selenium deficiency causes Keshan disease, an endemic cardiomyopathy found in selenium-poor regions, driven by insufficient cardiac glutathione peroxidase activity and consequent oxidant damage to myocardium. Affected hearts show necrosis and fibrosis with reduced antiviral and antioxidant defenses. The directionality is nutrient lack to enzyme failure to tissue injury. A caveat is that coxsackievirus infection interacts with the deficiency, so Keshan disease is not purely a selenium-deficiency disorder.
context.zh-TW: Selenium deficiency 會導致 Keshan disease，這是一種在 selenium 貧乏地區發現的地方性心肌病變，其原因是心臟 glutathione peroxidase 活性不足以及隨之而來的心肌氧化損傷。受影響的心臟顯示 necrosis 和 fibrosis 的抗病毒和抗氧化防禦能力降低。方向性是營養缺乏、酵素衰竭、組織損傷。需要注意的是，柯薩奇病毒感染與缺乏症相互作用，因此 Keshan disease 並不純粹是 selenium 缺乏症。

context.en-US: Lipid peroxidation is initiated by hydroxyl radicals that abstract a hydrogen atom from bis-allylic methylene groups of polyunsaturated fatty acids, creating a carbon-centered lipid radical. This radical rapidly adds oxygen to form a lipid peroxyl radical that propagates the chain by attacking neighboring lipids. The directionality is radical to lipid, seeding autocatalytic membrane damage. A caveat is that other initiators (singlet oxygen, peroxynitrite, lipoxygenases) can also start peroxidation, so hydroxyl radicals are sufficient but not unique.
context.zh-TW: Lipid peroxidation 是由 hydroxyl radicals 引發的，hydroxyl radicals 從 polyunsaturated fatty acids 的雙烯丙基亞甲基中抽像出一個氫原子，產生一個以碳為中心的脂質自由基。該自由基快速添加氧氣，形成脂質過氧自由基，透過攻擊鄰近的脂質來傳播該鏈。方向性對脂質、種子自催化膜損傷具有根本性。需要注意的是，其他引發劑（singlet oxygen、peroxynitrite、脂氧合酶）也可以啟動過氧化，因此 hydroxyl radicals 足夠但不是唯一的。

context.en-US: Lipid peroxidation produces malondialdehyde (MDA), a three-carbon dialdehyde arising from cyclization and fragmentation of peroxidized polyunsaturated fatty acids such as arachidonic acid. MDA is reactive and forms adducts with proteins and DNA, contributing to downstream toxicity. The directionality is membrane damage yielding a diffusible, immunogenic byproduct. A caveat is that MDA is one of many aldehyde products, so its measurement captures only part of the peroxidation burden. MDA forms under both physiological and pathological conditions and is the most commonly measured TBARS-based endpoint in redox research.
context.zh-TW: Lipid peroxidation 產生 malondialdehyde (MDA)，一種三碳二醛，由過氧化 polyunsaturated fatty acids（例如花生四烯酸）環化和裂解產生。 MDA 具有反應性，可與 proteins 和 DNA 形成加合物，導致下游毒性。方向性是膜損傷，產生可擴散的免疫原性副產物。需要注意的是，MDA 是眾多醛類產品之一，因此其測量僅捕獲部分過氧化負擔。 MDA 在生理和病理條件下形成，是氧化還原研究中最常測量的基於 TBARS 的終點。

context.en-US: Lipid peroxidation produces 4-hydroxynonenal (4-HNE), a highly reactive alpha,beta-unsaturated aldehyde generated mainly from n-6 polyunsaturated fatty acids. 4-HNE forms Michael adducts with protein cysteine, histidine, and lysine residues, altering enzyme function and signaling. The directionality is membrane oxidation yielding a potent endogenous electrophile. A caveat is that at low concentrations 4-HNE can act as a signaling molecule inducing adaptive responses, blurring the line between damage and signal.
context.zh-TW: Lipid peroxidation 產生 4-hydroxynonenal (4-HNE)，這是一種主要由 n-6 polyunsaturated fatty acids 產生的高反應性 α,β-不飽和醛。 4-HNE 與蛋白質半胱胺酸、組胺酸和離胺酸殘基形成邁可加合物，改變酵素功能和訊號傳導。方向性是膜氧化產生有效的內源性親電子試劑。需要注意的是，在低濃度下，4-HNE 可以充當誘導適應性反應的訊號分子，模糊損傷和訊號之間的界限。

context.en-US: Vitamin E inhibits lipid peroxidation as a chain-breaking antioxidant that donates a hydrogen atom to lipid peroxyl radicals, converting them to stable hydroperoxides and yielding a relatively unreactive tocopheroxyl radical. Embedded in the membrane lipid bilayer, it intercepts chain propagation at the site of peroxidation. The directionality is protective termination of radical chains. A caveat is that the tocopheroxyl radical must be regenerated by vitamin C or CoQ10; otherwise vitamin E is consumed and protection is exhausted.
context.zh-TW: Vitamin E 作為一種斷鍊抗氧化劑抑制 lipid peroxidation，該抗氧化劑向脂質過氧自由基提供一個氫原子，將其轉化為穩定的氫過氧化物，並產生相對不活潑的生育酚自由基。它嵌入膜脂雙層中，在過氧化位點攔截鏈中增長。方向性是自由基鏈的保護性終止。需要注意的是，生育酚自由基必須由維生素 C 或 CoQ10 再生；否則vitamin E被消耗，保護耗盡。

context.en-US: Lipid peroxidation contributes to atherosclerosis because oxidative modification of LDL, driven by lipid peroxidation products, is an initiating event in foam-cell formation and plaque development. Oxidized LDL is taken up by scavenger receptors on macrophages, accelerating lesion growth. The directionality runs from membrane or lipoprotein oxidation to innate immune retention in the artery wall. A caveat is that lipid peroxidation is one of several LDL-modifying pathways (e.g., enzymatic, glycation) relevant to atherogenesis.
context.zh-TW: Lipid peroxidation 對 atherosclerosis 做出貢獻，因為由 lipid peroxidation 產品驅動的 LDL 氧化修飾是泡沫細胞形成和斑塊形成的起始事件。 Oxidized LDL 被巨噬細胞上的清道夫受體吸收，加速病灶生長。方向性從膜或脂蛋白氧化到動脈壁的先天免疫保留。需要注意的是，lipid peroxidation 是與動脈粥狀硬化形成相關的幾種 LDL 修飾途徑（例如酵素、糖化）之一。

context.en-US: Lipid peroxidation contributes to ferroptosis because iron-dependent accumulation of phospholipid hydroperoxides in the membrane is the executioner of this non-apoptotic cell death. When GPx4 is overwhelmed or inactivated, peroxidation proceeds unchecked and membranes lose integrity. The directionality is peroxidation to lethal membrane failure. A caveat is that ferroptosis also requires available polyunsaturated phospholipids and labile iron, so peroxidation alone is necessary but not sufficient.
context.zh-TW: Lipid peroxidation 有助於 ferroptosis，因為 iron 依賴性磷脂氫過氧化物在膜中的累積是這種非凋亡細胞死亡的執行者。當 GPx4 被淹沒或失去活性時，過氧化反應會不受控制地進行，膜會失去完整性。方向性是過氧化導致致命的膜失效。需要注意的是，ferroptosis 還需要可用的多元不飽和磷脂和不穩定的 iron，因此單獨的過氧化是必要的，但還不夠。

context.en-US: Malondialdehyde is a biomarker for lipid peroxidation, widely measured in plasma, urine, and tissue as a marker of chronic oxidative stress. Its levels reflect the integrated burden of polyunsaturated fatty-acid peroxidation across membranes and lipoproteins. The directionality is damage to measurable product. A caveat is that MDA is also influenced by diet and exogenous sources, and assay specificity (e.g., TBARS) can be confounded by other carbonyls. MDA levels in plasma and tissue rise steeply when antioxidant defenses are overwhelmed, making it a convenient correlate of ongoing membrane oxidation.
context.zh-TW: Malondialdehyde 是 lipid peroxidation 的生物標記物，在血漿、尿液和組織中廣泛測量，作為慢性 oxidative stress 的標記。其水平反映了多元不飽和脂肪酸過氧化 across 膜和 lipoproteins 的綜合負擔。方向性是對可測量產品的損害。需要注意的是，MDA 也受到飲食和外源的影響，並且測定特異性（例如 TBARS）可能會受到其他羰基的影響。當抗氧化防禦被壓倒時，血漿和組織中的 MDA 水平急劇上升，使其成為正在進行的膜氧化的便捷關聯。

context.en-US: Malondialdehyde forms adducts with DNA, most notably the M1dG lesion with deoxyguanosine, which mispairs with adenine during replication and induces G to T transversions. Such mutations in oncogenes or tumor suppressors can promote carcinogenesis. The directionality is lipid-peroxidation product to genotoxic lesion. A caveat is that M1dG is only one of several DNA adducts from lipid peroxidation, and repair pathways partially mitigate its mutagenic potential. Beyond M1dG, MDA also generates cross-links between DNA and proteins, expanding the spectrum of genotoxic damage it can inflict.
context.zh-TW: Malondialdehyde 與 DNA 形成加合物，最顯著的是 M1dG 與脫氧鳥苷的損傷，脫氧鳥苷在複製過程中與腺嘌呤錯配並誘導 G 到 T 顛換。癌基因或腫瘤抑制基因的此類突變可以促進癌症發生。其方向性是脂質過氧化產物對遺傳毒性損傷的作用。需要注意的是，M1dG 只是 lipid peroxidation 的幾種 DNA 加合物之一，修復途徑部分減輕了其致突變潛力。除了 M1dG 之外，MDA 還產生 DNA 和 proteins 之間的 cross 鏈​​接，擴大了它可能造成的基因毒性損害的範圍。

context.en-US: Malondialdehyde modifies cholesterol by forming MDA-lysine adducts on LDL apolipoproteins, creating MDA-LDL that is recognized by macrophage scavenger receptors. This modification enhances unregulated uptake and foam-cell formation in the arterial wall. The directionality is peroxidation product to LDL modification to atherogenic uptake. A caveat is that other aldehydes (4-HNE, acrolein) modify LDL similarly, so MDA-LDL is a representative but not exclusive epitope. MDA-modified LDL is pro-inflammatory and immunogenic, and its accumulation in plaques is used as a marker of oxidative modification of lipoproteins.
context.zh-TW: Malondialdehyde 透過在 LDL apolipoproteins 上形成 MDA-賴氨酸加合物來修飾 cholesterol，從而產生可被巨噬細胞清道夫受體辨識的 MDA-LDL。這種修飾增強了動脈壁中不受調節的吸收和泡沫細胞的形成。方向性是過氧化產物到低密度脂蛋白修飾到致動脈粥狀硬化的攝取。需要注意的是，其他醛（4-HNE、丙烯醛）也會類似地修飾 LDL，因此 MDA-LDL 是代表性表位，但不是唯一的表位。 MDA 修飾的 LDL 具有促發炎性和免疫原性，其在斑塊中的累積可用作 lipoproteins 氧化修飾的標記物。

context.en-US: Elevated MDA is associated with cardiovascular disease, being increased in plasma and within atherosclerotic plaque tissue relative to healthy vessels. It reflects oxidant stress in the vessel wall that promotes LDL oxidation and endothelial dysfunction. The directionality is oxidative burden to biomarker elevation. A caveat is that association does not prove causality, and MDA can be a consequence as well as a contributor to vascular pathology. The elevations are seen before clinical events in some cohorts, supporting MDA as a prognostic rather than merely descriptive biomarker.
context.zh-TW: 升高的MDA與cardiovascular disease相關，相對於健康血管，血漿中和ros硬化斑塊組織內的MDA升高。它反映了血管壁中促進 LDL 氧化和 endothelial dysfunction 的氧化壓力。方向性是生物標記升高的氧化負擔。需要注意的是，相關性並不能證明因果關係，MDA 可能是血管病理學的結果，也可能是其促成因素。在一些隊列中，在臨床事件發生之前就可以看到這種升高，這支持 MDA 作為一種預後指標而不僅僅是描述性生物標記。

context.en-US: Elevated MDA is associated with diabetes mellitus, where plasma and erythrocyte MDA rise and correlate with HbA1c and glycemic burden. Hyperglycemia drives mitochondrial superoxide and advanced glycation that amplify lipid peroxidation. The directionality is metabolic dysfunction to oxidative marker. A caveat is that MDA elevation is a downstream indicator and improves with glycemic control rather than being a primary diabetic lesion. Oxidative stress from hyperglycemia, mitochondrial leak, and advanced glycation all feed MDA production, linking glycemic burden to systemic lipid oxidation.
context.zh-TW: MDA 升高與 diabetes mellitus 相關，其中血漿和紅血球 MDA 升高並與 HbA1c 和血糖負荷相關。高血糖驅動mitochondria1超氧化物和高級糖化，放大lipid peroxidation。方向性是氧化標記物的代謝功能障礙。需要注意的是，MDA 升高是一個下游指標，可隨著血糖控製而改善，而不是糖尿病的主要病變。高血糖引起的 Oxidative stress、mitochondria1 滲漏和晚期糖化都會促進 MDA 的產生，將血糖負擔與全身脂質氧化聯繫起來。

context.en-US: Elevated MDA is associated with neurodegeneration, with higher levels reported in CSF and brain tissue in Alzheimer's and Parkinson's disease. It marks membrane damage in neurons already stressed by protein misfolding and mitochondrial failure. The directionality is neuronal oxidant stress to biomarker. A caveat is that MDA elevation may be secondary to neurodegeneration, and its usefulness as an early diagnostic marker remains limited. MDA adducts on neuronal proteins may also impair function directly, beyond serving as a passive marker of lipid oxidation.
context.zh-TW: MDA 升高與 neurodegeneration 相關，據報道，阿茲海默症和 Parkinson's disease 患者的腦脊髓液和腦組織中 MDA 水平較高。它標誌著已經因蛋白質錯誤折疊和mitochondria1失敗而受到壓力的神經元的膜損傷。方向性是神經元對生物標記的氧化壓力。需要注意的是，MDA 升高可能繼發於 neurodegeneration，且其作為早期診斷標記物的作用仍然有限。神經元 proteins 上的 MDA 加合物除了作為脂質氧化的被動標記物外，還可能直接損害功能。

context.en-US: 8-oxo-2'-deoxyguanosine is a biomarker for oxidative stress, representing the major product of DNA oxidation and one of the most widely used indicators of oxidative DNA damage in urine and tissue. Its steady-state level integrates the rate of formation by ROS and the efficiency of repair and sanitization. The directionality is DNA oxidation to measurable lesion. A caveat is that sample handling and artifactual oxidation during extraction can inflate measurements, requiring careful standardized assays.
context.zh-TW: 8-oxo-2'-deoxyguanosine 是 oxidative stress 的生物標記物，代表 DNA 氧化的主要產物，也是尿液和組織中最廣泛使用的氧化 DNA damage 指標之一。其穩態水準綜合了ROS的形成速率以及修復和消毒的效率。方向性是DNA氧化至可測量的損傷。需要注意的是，樣品處理和萃取過程中的人為氧化可能會導致測量結果誇大，需要仔細的標準化測定。

context.en-US: 8-oxo-2'-deoxyguanosine is formed by hydroxyl radicals that attack the C8 position of guanine in DNA, producing the oxidized base lesion directly at the nucleoside. This is the canonical and most abundant oxidative DNA modification. The directionality is radical to base oxidation. A caveat is that other oxidants (singlet oxygen, peroxynitrite, photoexcitation) also generate 8-oxodG, so its presence is not specific to hydroxyl radicals alone. The lesion is mutagenic because it mispairs with adenine, and its abundance in tissue is used as a sensitive index of oxidative DNA insult.
context.zh-TW: 8-oxo-2'-deoxyguanosine是由hydroxyl radicals攻擊DNA中鳥嘌呤的C8位置形成的，直接在核苷處產生氧化鹼基損傷。這是典型且最豐富的氧化DNA修飾。方向性對於鹼氧化是激進的。需要注意的是，其他氧化劑（singlet oxygen、peroxynitrite、光激發）也會產生 8-oxodG，因此它的存在並非僅針對 hydroxyl radicals。此病變具有誘變性，因為它與腺嘌呤錯配，並且其在組織中的豐度被用作氧化 DNA 損傷的敏感指標。

context.en-US: OGG1 repairs 8-oxo-2'-deoxyguanosine as a bifunctional DNA glycosylase that excises the damaged base and cleaves the backbone, initiating base-excision repair that liberates free 8-oxodG. This prevents the lesion from mispairing with adenine during replication. The directionality is lesion to repair pathway. A caveat is that OGG1's role in processing 8-oxodG is most critical in nuclear DNA, while mitochondrial isoforms handle mtDNA damage with somewhat different kinetics. OGG1 also releases the free 8-oxodG into urine, which is why urinary levels of the lesion report both damage and active repair.
context.zh-TW: OGG1 作為雙功能 DNA 糖基化酶修復 8-oxo-2'-deoxyguanosine，切除受損鹼基並切割主鏈，啟動鹼基切除修復，釋放遊離 8-oxodG。這可以防止複製過程中病變與腺嘌呤錯配。方向性是損傷修復途徑。需要注意的是，OGG1 在核子 DNA 中處理 8-oxodG 的作用最為關鍵，而 mitochondria1 亞型以有些不同的動力學處理 mtDNA damage。 OGG1 也將遊離的 8-oxodG 釋放到尿液中，這就是為什麼病變的尿液水平報告損傷和主動修復的原因。

context.en-US: 8-oxo-2'-deoxyguanosine causes G to T transversions because the oxidized base pairs promiscuously with adenine during replication, so a G:C pair becomes an A:T pair after a round of replication and repair. These transversions are signature mutations in many cancers. The directionality is miscoding lesion to mutagenic outcome. A caveat is that accurate repair by OGG1 before replication averts most mutations, so only unrepaired lesions are mutagenic. G to T transversions are among the most frequent mutations found in oncogenes and tumor suppressors in human cancers, underscoring the relevance of this lesion.
context.zh-TW: 8-oxo-2'-deoxyguanosine 會導致 G 到 T 顛換，因為複製過程中氧化鹼基與腺嘌呤混雜配對，因此 G:C 對經過一輪複製和修復後變成 A:T 對。這些顛換是許多 cancer 的特徵突變。方向性是將病變錯誤編碼為誘變結果。需要注意的是，複製前透過 OGG1 進行的精確修復可以避免大多數突變，因此只有未修復的損傷才具有突變性。 G 至 T 顛換是人類 cancer 癌基因和腫瘤抑制基因中最常見的突變之一，強調了這種病變的相關性。

context.en-US: MTH1 prevents 8-oxo-dGTP incorporation by hydrolyzing the oxidized nucleotide triphosphate to 8-oxo-dGMP, sanitizing the dNTP pool before DNA polymerase can insert it. This provides a front-line defense that complements OGG1's post-replicative repair. The directionality is sanitization to mutation prevention. A caveat is that MTH1 knockout is tolerated in many contexts because backup repair exists, though cancer cells can become dependent on it (synthetic lethal vulnerability). Because DNA polymerases preferentially misinsert the oxidized nucleotide opposite adenine, MTH1 action is essential for maintaining replication fidelity in oxidatively stressed cells.
context.zh-TW: MTH1 透過將氧化的核苷酸三磷酸水解為 8-oxo-dGMP 來防止 8-oxo-dGTP incorporation，在 DNA 聚合酶插入之前對 dNTP 池進行消毒。這提供了前線防禦，補充了OGG1的複製後修復。方向性是淨化到突變預防。需要注意的是，由於存在備份修復，MTH1 敲除在許多情況下都是可以容忍的，儘管 cancer 細胞可能會依賴它（合成致命漏洞）。由於 DNA 聚合酶優先錯誤地將氧化核苷酸插入腺嘌呤對面，因此 MTH1 作用對於維持氧化壓力細胞中的複製保真度至關重要。

context.en-US: Elevated 8-oxodG is associated with cancer, being increased in lung, breast, bladder, and colorectal cancers where it marks heightened oxidative DNA damage and genomic instability. Persistent oxidative lesions increase mutation burden that can drive oncogenesis. The directionality is oxidative damage to cancer risk or marker. A caveat is that elevated 8-oxodG may be a consequence of the tumor's metabolic and inflammatory state as much as a cause. Urinary and tissue 8-oxodG are frequently elevated in cancer patients and have been proposed as markers of exposure and disease burden.
context.zh-TW: Elevated 8-oxodG 與 cancer 相關，在肺、乳腺、膀胱和結直腸 cancer 中增加，標誌著氧化 DNA damage 和基因組不穩定性的增強。持續的氧化損傷會增加突變負擔，從而促進腫瘤發生。方向性是對cancer風險或標記的氧化損傷。需要注意的是，elevated 8-oxodG 可能是腫瘤代謝和發炎狀態的結果，也可能是原因。 cancer 患者的尿液和組織中 8-oxodG 經常升高，並已被提議作為暴露和疾病負擔的標記。

context.en-US: NADPH oxidase produces superoxide radicals by catalyzing the transfer of electrons from cytosolic NADPH to molecular oxygen at the plasma or phagosomal membrane. This deliberate, enzyme-driven generation contrasts with incidental mitochondrial leak and is tightly regulated by subunit assembly. The directionality is NADPH oxidation to superoxide formation. A caveat is that physiological NOX activity supports signaling and immunity, while pathological overactivation drives disease. The enzyme exists as several isoforms (NOX1-5, DUOX1/2) that share the core NADPH-to-oxygen electron transfer but differ in regulation, subunit partners, and tissue distribution.
context.zh-TW: NADPH oxidase 透過催化電子從胞質 NADPH 轉移到質膜或吞噬體膜上的分子氧來產生 superoxide radicals。這種有意的、酶驅動的生成與偶然的mitochondria1洩漏形成對比，並且受到亞基組裝的嚴格調節。方向性是 NADPH 氧化成超氧化物的形成。需要注意的是，生理性 NOX 活性支持訊號傳導和免疫，而病理性過度活化則會導致疾病。此酵素以多種異構體（NOX1-5、DUOX1/2）的形式存在，它們共享核心的 NADPH 至氧電子轉移，但在調節、亞基夥伴和組織分佈方面有所不同。

context.en-US: NOX4 produces hydrogen peroxide rather than superoxide because it is constitutively active and dismutates its product internally, releasing H2O2 as the main extracellular and matrix signaling oxidant. This makes NOX4 a major source of the diffusible second messenger in fibroblasts and the kidney. The directionality is enzyme activity to H2O2 signaling. A caveat is that NOX4's H2O2 output is context-dependent and can be both profibrotic via TGF-beta signaling and protective depending on tissue. NOX4 is unique among NOX isoforms in being constitutively active and regulated primarily at the transcriptional level, for instance by TGF-beta and hypoxia.
context.zh-TW: NOX4 產生 hydrogen peroxide 而不是超氧化物，因為它具有組成活性並在內部歧化其產物，釋放 H2O2 作為主要的細胞外和基質信號傳導氧化劑。這使得 NOX4 成為成纖維細胞和腎臟中可擴散第二信使的主要來源。方向性是酵素對 H2O2 訊號傳導的活性。需要注意的是，NOX4 的 H2O2 輸出是上下文相關的，並且可以透過 TGF-beta 訊號傳導促進纖維化，也可以根據組織提供保護作用。 NOX4 在 NOX 同工型中是獨特的，因為它具有組成型活性，並且主要在轉錄層面上受到調節，例如透過 TGF-beta 和缺氧調節。

context.en-US: NADPH oxidase activates NF-kappaB because the ROS it produces (especially H2O2) oxidize inhibitory proteins and activate upstream kinases such as IKK and PKC that release NF-kappaB for nuclear translocation. This links redox signaling to inflammatory gene transcription. The directionality is ROS to transcription-factor activation. A caveat is that NF-kappaB and ROS engage in a feed-forward loop, with NF-kappaB also inducing NOX subunits, so causality is bidirectional. This NOX-to-NF-kappaB axis links environmental and inflammatory stimuli to amplification of cytokine and adhesion-molecule expression in the vessel wall.
context.zh-TW: NADPH oxidase 活化 NF-kappaB，因為它產生的 ROS（特別是 H2O2）氧化抑制性 proteins 並活化上游激酶（例如 IKK 和 PKC），釋放 NF-kappaB 以進行核轉位。這將氧化還原訊號與發炎基因轉錄聯繫起來。轉錄因子活化的方向性是 ROS。需要注意的是，NF-kappaB 和 ROS 參與前饋循環，NF-kappaB 也誘導 NOX 亞基，因此因果關係是雙向的。此 NOX-to-NF-kappaB 軸將 environ 精神刺激和發炎刺激與血管壁中細胞激素和黏附分子表達的放大聯繫起來。

context.en-US: NOX2 deficiency causes chronic granulomatous disease, a group of genetic defects in NOX2 (gp91phox) subunits that abolish the phagocyte respiratory burst. Patients suffer recurrent, life-threatening bacterial and fungal infections due to failure to generate microbicidal ROS. The directionality is enzyme defect to immunodeficiency. A caveat is that the disease severity varies with the specific mutation and residual oxidase activity, and some organisms evade even normal ROS killing. X-linked CGD from CYBB mutations is most common, and patients show granuloma formation, colitis-like inflammation, and susceptibility to catalase-positive organisms.
context.zh-TW: NOX2 缺陷會導致 chronic granulomatous disease，這是 NOX2 (gp91phox) 亞基中的一組遺傳缺陷，可消除吞噬細胞 respiratory burst。由於無法產生殺菌劑 ROS，患者會重複遭受危及生命的細菌和真菌感染。方向性是酵素缺陷到免疫缺陷。需要注意的是，疾病的嚴重程度會隨著特定突變和殘留氧化酶活性的不同而變化，有些生物體甚至會逃避正常的 ROS 殺滅。 CYBB 突變導致的 X 連鎖 CGD 最為常見，患者表現出肉芽腫形成、結腸炎樣發炎以及對 catalase 陽性微生物的易感性。

context.en-US: NADPH oxidase is activated by angiotensin II via the AT1 receptor, which triggers assembly of NOX isoforms (especially NOX1) in vascular smooth muscle and endothelial cells. This couples the renin-angiotensin system to vascular oxidative stress and hypertension. The directionality is hormone to enzyme activation. A caveat is that AT1 signaling also activates other ROS sources and inflammatory pathways, so NOX is a major but not sole mediator of angiotensin-II effects. Angiotensin-II-driven NOX activation is a well-established mechanism in hypertension, contributing to vascular remodeling and target-organ damage.
context.zh-TW: NADPH oxidase 被 angiotensin II 透過 AT1 受體激活，從而觸發血管平滑肌和內皮細胞中 NOX 同工型（尤其是 NOX1）的組裝。這將腎素-血管緊張素系統與血管 oxidative stress 和高血壓聯繫起來。方向性是荷爾蒙到酵素的活化。需要注意的是，AT1 訊號傳導也會活化其他 ROS 來源和發炎途徑，因此 NOX 是血管張力素 II 效應的主要但不是唯一的介質。血管張力素 II 驅動的 NOX 活化是高血壓的一種成熟機制，有助於血管重塑和目標器官損傷。

context.en-US: NOX2 contributes to ischemia-reperfusion injury because neutrophils and resident cells generate a burst of NOX2-derived superoxide upon reperfusion when oxygen returns to ischemic tissue. This burst, together with mitochondrial ROS, oxidizes lipids, proteins, and DNA and recruits inflammation. The directionality is reperfusion to NOX2 activation to tissue damage. A caveat is that NOX2 is one of several ROS sources in reperfusion, and ischemia itself also primes the injury. NOX2 inhibition or genetic knockout reduces infarct size in experimental models, confirming its causal role in reperfusion injury.
context.zh-TW: NOX2 有助於 ischemia-reperfusion injury，因為當氧氣回到缺血組織時，嗜中性球和駐留細胞在再灌注時會產生大量 NOX2 衍生的超氧化物。這種爆發與 mitochondrial ROS 一起氧化脂質、proteins 和 DNA 並引發發炎。方向性是再灌注至NOX2活化至組織損傷。需要注意的是，NOX2 是再灌注中幾個 ROS 來源之一，缺血本身也會引發損傷。 NOX2 抑製或基因敲除可減少實驗模型中的梗塞面積，證實其在再灌注損傷中的因果作用。

context.en-US: NOX2 contributes to neurodegeneration through its activation in microglia, where sustained superoxide production drives chronic neuroinflammation and neuronal injury. Microglial ROS amplify cytokine release and exacerbate protein-misfolding pathologies. The directionality is glial oxidase activation to neuronal damage. A caveat is that microglial ROS also serves host defense, and the pathological transition depends on failed resolution of inflammation. Inhibition of microglial NOX2 attenuates dopaminergic neuron loss in Parkinson's disease models, highlighting a druggable pathway.
context.zh-TW: NOX2 透過在小膠質細胞中的活化對 neurodegeneration 做出貢獻，小膠質細胞中持續的超氧化物產生會導致慢性神經發炎和神經元損傷。小膠質細胞 ROS 會放大細胞激素的釋放並加劇蛋白質錯誤摺疊病理。方向性是神經膠質氧化酶活化對神經元損傷。需要注意的是，小膠質細胞 ROS 也起到宿主防禦的作用，病理轉變取決於發炎消退失敗。抑制小膠質細胞 NOX2 可減輕 Parkinson's disease 模型中 dopaminergic 神經元的損失，突顯了可藥物途徑。

context.en-US: Peroxynitrite is formed by superoxide radicals through their near-instantaneous reaction with nitric oxide, yielding the potent oxidant and nitrating species ONOO-. This couples two radical species into one hybrid effector. The directionality is radical-radical combination. A caveat is that the reaction competes with SOD for superoxide, so the relative activities of NOX, NOS, and SOD determine peroxynitrite yield. The reaction effectively couples two signaling systems, converting a protective vasodilator into a cytotoxic oxidant, and its rate constant (about 10^10 M-1 s-1) is diffusion-limited, so peroxynitrite forms whenever the two radicals meet.
context.zh-TW: Peroxynitrite 是由 superoxide radicals 透過與 nitric oxide 近乎瞬時的反應形成的，產生有效的氧化劑和硝化物質 ONOO-。這將兩種自由基物種耦合成一個混合效應器。方向性是激進-激進的結合。需要注意的是，該反應與 SOD 競爭超氧化物，因此 NOX、NOS 和 SOD 的相對活性決定了 peroxynitrite 的產量。此反應有效地耦合兩個訊號系統，將保護性血管舒張劑轉化為細胞毒性氧化劑，其速率常數（約 10^10 M-1 s-1）是擴散限制的，因此每當兩個自由基相遇時就會形成 peroxynitrite。

context.en-US: Peroxynitrite is formed by nitric oxide reacting with superoxide at a rate (k approximately 1.6 x 10^10 M-1 s-1) that often outcompetes superoxide dismutase, making NO availability a key determinant of peroxynitrite formation. This places iNOS induction as a major driver of peroxynitrite in inflammation. The directionality is NO to hybrid oxidant. A caveat is that peroxynitrite formation requires co-localized NO and superoxide, so spatial compartmentalization strongly modulates its production. This coupling means that inflammatory conditions that simultaneously induce iNOS and NOX drive high peroxynitrite flux and subsequent tissue nitration.
context.zh-TW: Peroxynitrite 是由 nitric oxide 與超氧化物以通常超過 superoxide dismutase 的速率（k 約為 1.6 x 10^10 M-1 s-1）反應形成的，使得 NO 可用性成為 peroxynitrite 形成的關鍵決定因素。這使得 iNOS 感應成為 peroxynitrite 發炎的主要驅動因素。混合氧化劑的方向性為NO。需要注意的是，peroxynitrite 的形成需要共定位的 NO 和超氧化物，因此空間分隔強烈調節其產生。這種耦合意味著同時誘導 iNOS 和 NOX 的發炎條件驅動高 peroxynitrite 通量和隨後的組織硝化。

context.en-US: Peroxynitrite causes nitrative stress by oxidizing and nitrating biomolecules, most characteristically forming 3-nitrotyrosine on proteins, an irreversible modification that can inactivate enzymes. It also nitrates nucleic acids and lipids, broadening its toxic footprint. The directionality is hybrid oxidant to nitrative modification. A caveat is that 3-nitrotyrosine can also arise from other nitrating species such as myeloperoxidase-derived species, so it is not exclusively peroxynitrite-specific.
context.zh-TW: Peroxynitrite 透過氧化和硝化生物分子產生 nitrative stress，最典型的是在 proteins 上形成 3-nitrotyrosine，這是一種可以使酵素失去活性的不可逆修飾。它還會硝酸化 nucleic acids 和脂質，從而擴大其毒性足跡。方向性是混合氧化劑與硝化改質。需要注意的是，3-nitrotyrosine 也可以由其他硝化物質產生，例如 myeloperoxidase 衍生物質，因此它並不完全是 peroxynitrite 特有的。

context.en-US: Peroxynitrite depletes nitric oxide by reacting with it to form peroxynitrite, thereby lowering bioavailable NO and impairing vasodilation and endothelial function. This converts a vasoprotective signal into oxidative and nitrative damage. The directionality is NO consumption to endothelial dysfunction. A caveat is that peroxynitrite also nitrates prostacyclin synthase and other vasoregulators, so NO loss is one of several endothelial insults. The loss of NO also removes its anti-inflammatory and antithrombotic actions, compounding the injury beyond simple loss of vasodilation.
context.zh-TW: Peroxynitrite 透過與 nitric oxide 反應形成 peroxynitrite 來耗盡 nitric oxide，從而降低生物可利用的 NO 並損害 vasodilation 和內皮功能。這將血管保護訊號轉化為氧化和硝化損傷。方向性是對endothelial dysfunction無消費。需要注意的是，peroxynitrite 也硝酸化 prostacyclin 合成酶和其他血管調節劑，因此 NO 損失是幾種內皮損傷之一。 NO 的缺失也會消除其抗發炎和抗血栓作用，使損傷比單純的 vasodilation 缺失更嚴重。

context.en-US: Peroxynitrite inactivates MnSOD by nitrating Tyr34 in the mitochondrial matrix enzyme, impairing its ability to dismutate superoxide. This creates a vicious cycle in which peroxynitrite both consumes NO and disables a key superoxide-scavenging enzyme. The directionality is nitration to loss of antioxidant defense. A caveat is that the magnitude of MnSOD inactivation depends on local peroxynitrite concentration and the availability of peroxynitrite scavengers such as uric acid. Because MnSOD is a first-line mitochondrial defense, its inactivation amplifies superoxide levels and further feeds peroxynitrite production in a self-sustaining loop.
context.zh-TW: Peroxynitrite 透過硝化 mitochondria1 基質酶中的 Tyr34 來滅活 MnSOD，削弱其歧化超氧化物的能力。這就形成了一個惡性循環，其中 peroxynitrite 既消耗 NO，又使一種關鍵的超氧化物清除酶失效。方向性是硝化到抗氧化防禦喪失。需要注意的是，MnSOD 失活的程度取決於當地 peroxynitrite 濃度和 peroxynitrite 清除劑（例如 uric acid）的可用性。因為MnSOD是一線mitochondria1防禦，所以它的失活會放大超氧化物水平並進一步在自我維持循環中促進peroxynitrite的產生。

context.en-US: 3-nitrotyrosine is a biomarker for nitrative stress, reflecting peroxynitrite- or myeloperoxidase-mediated nitration of protein tyrosines. It is elevated across many inflammatory and neurodegenerative conditions. The directionality is nitrative insult to stable protein modification. A caveat is that 3-nitrotyrosine can arise from multiple nitrating pathways and can be repaired or degraded, so it indicates historical rather than instantaneous nitrative load. Quantification in plasma, CSF, and tissue by mass spectrometry or immunoassay has made 3-NT a standard endpoint in redox biomarker studies.
context.zh-TW: 3-nitrotyrosine 是 nitrative stress 的生物標記物，反映 peroxynitrite 或 myeloperoxidase 介導的蛋白質 tyrosines 硝化。它會導致許多發炎和神經退化性疾病。方向性是對穩定蛋白質修飾的硝化損害。需要注意的是，3-nitrotyrosine 可以由多種硝化途徑產生，並且可以修復或降解，因此它表示歷史硝化負荷而不是瞬時硝化負荷。透過質譜或免疫分析對血漿、腦脊髓液和組織進行定量，使 3-NT 成為氧化還原生物標記研究的標準終點。

context.en-US: Peroxynitrite nitrates alpha-synuclein, and nitrated alpha-synuclein is more prone to aggregation and fibrillation, hallmarks of Parkinson's disease pathology. Nitration at tyrosine residues stabilizes protofibrils and may seed Lewy-body formation. The directionality is nitrative modification to misfolding propensity. A caveat is that aggregation is also driven by many non-oxidative factors, so nitration accelerates rather than solely causes the process. Elevated nitrated alpha-synuclein is found in Lewy bodies and in the CSF of Parkinson's patients, supporting a pathogenic role for nitration.
context.zh-TW: Peroxynitrite 硝酸鹽 alpha-synuclein，硝化 alpha-synuclein 更容易發生聚集和纖維化，這是 Parkinson's disease 病理學的標誌。 tyrosine 殘基上的硝化可穩定原纖維並可能引發路易氏體形成。方向性是對錯誤摺疊傾向的硝基修飾。需要注意的是，聚集也是由許多非氧化因素驅動的，因此硝化會加速而不是僅僅導致該過程。在路易氏體和巴金森氏症患者的腦脊髓液中發現硝化 alpha-synuclein 升高，支持硝化的致病作用。

context.en-US: Uric acid scavenges peroxynitrite, acting as a physiologic antioxidant in humans (who lack the uricase that degrades it) at the high plasma concentrations typical of the species. It reacts with peroxynitrite to limit tyrosine nitration and lipid oxidation. The directionality is scavenger to oxidant neutralization. A caveat is that urate is also pro-oxidant and pro-inflammatory at high levels and contributes to gout, so its net effect is concentration- and context-dependent. Because humans and great apes lost uricase, urate circulates at near-saturating concentrations, providing a constitutive antioxidant buffer in plasma.
context.zh-TW: Uric acid 清除 peroxynitrite，在人類（缺乏降解它的尿酸酶）中在該物種典型的高血漿濃度下充當生理抗氧化劑。它與 peroxynitrite 反應，限制 tyrosine 硝化和脂質氧化。方向性是清除劑至氧化劑中和。需要注意的是，高水平的尿酸鹽還具有促氧化和促炎作用，並會導致痛風，因此其淨效應取決於濃度和環境。由於人類和類人猿失去了尿酸酶，尿酸鹽以接近飽和的濃度循環，在血漿中提供了組成型抗氧化緩衝劑。

context.en-US: Reactive nitrogen species are derived from nitric oxide, which combines with superoxide or other radicals to yield peroxynitrite, nitrogen dioxide, and related species. Thus NO is the nitrogenous precursor of the broader RNS family. The directionality is NO to RNS expansion. A caveat is that RNS also include species from myeloperoxidase and other enzymatic pathways, so RNS origin is not exclusively nitric-oxide-derived. Because NO is itself a free radical with signaling functions, RNS can be viewed as both downstream products and, under excess, pathological mediators of nitrative stress.
context.zh-TW: Reactive nitrogen species 衍生自 nitric oxide，它與超氧化物或其他自由基結合產生 peroxynitrite、二氧化氮和相關物質。因此，NO 是更廣泛的 RNS 家族的含氮前驅物。 RNS 擴展的方向性是「否」。需要注意的是，RNS 還包括來自 myeloperoxidase 和其他酶途徑的物種，因此 RNS 起源不僅來自一氧化氮​​。由於NO本身是具有訊號傳導功能的自由基，RNS既可以被視為下游產物，也可以被視為nitrative stress過量時的病理介質。

context.en-US: Reactive nitrogen species cause nitrative stress by oxidizing and nitrating proteins, lipids, and nucleic acids, often in coordination with reactive oxygen species. The combined oxidant and nitrative burden disrupts enzyme function and signaling. The directionality is RNS to nitrative damage. A caveat is that some RNS (e.g., low NO) are physiologically essential, so pathology requires excess or mislocalized production. The RNS burden is amplified when superoxide is abundant, since superoxide rapidly converts NO into the far more reactive peroxynitrite.
context.zh-TW: Reactive nitrogen species透過氧化和硝化proteins、脂質和nucleic acids而引起nitrative stress，通常與reactive oxygen species協同作用。氧化劑和硝基的結合負荷會破壞酵素的功能和訊號傳導。方向性是RNS對硝化損傷。需要注意的是，某些 RNS（例如，低 NO）在生理上是必需的，因此病理學需要過量或錯誤定位的產生。當超氧化物豐富時，RNS 負擔會放大，因為超氧化物會迅速將 NO 轉化為反應性更強的 peroxynitrite。

context.en-US: Inducible nitric oxide synthase produces nitric oxide at high, sustained flux after induction by pro-inflammatory cytokines (TNF-alpha, IL-1beta, IFN-gamma). This micromolar NO output supports macrophage killing of pathogens but also feeds peroxynitrite formation. The directionality is cytokine induction to NO burst. A caveat is that iNOS-derived NO is double-edged: antimicrobial at the cost of collateral nitrative tissue damage. iNOS produces orders of magnitude more NO than the constitutive isoforms and is largely calcium-independent, enabling sustained high-flux NO output for host defense.
context.zh-TW: Inducible nitric oxide synthase 在促發炎細胞激素（TNF-alpha、IL-1beta、IFN-gamma）誘導後以高、持續的通量產生 nitric oxide。這種微摩爾 NO 輸出支持巨噬細胞殺死病原體，但也促進 peroxynitrite 的形成。方向性是細胞激素誘導NO爆發。需要注意的是，iNOS 衍生的 NO 是一把雙面刃：抗菌的代價是附帶硝化組織損傷。 iNOS 產生的 NO 比組成型異構體多幾個數量級，並且在很大程度上不依賴鈣，從而能夠持續輸出高通量 NO 來進行宿主防禦。

context.en-US: Reactive nitrogen species contribute to cardiovascular disease when eNOS becomes uncoupled or iNOS is induced, converting NO physiology into peroxynitrite-mediated nitrative and oxidative injury. This promotes endothelial dysfunction, LDL modification, and plaque instability. The directionality is RNS to vascular damage. A caveat is that basal NO from eNOS is protective, so the disease association depends on the shift from coupled to uncoupled or inducible sources. This shift is now recognized as a unifying mechanism linking classic risk factors such as hyperglycemia, hyperlipidemia, and smoking to vascular oxidant injury.
context.zh-TW: 當 eNOS 解偶聯或 iNOS 被誘導時，Reactive nitrogen species 對 cardiovascular disease 做出貢獻，將 NO 生理學轉化為 peroxynitrite 介導的硝化和氧化損傷。這會促進 endothelial dysfunction、LDL 修飾和斑塊不穩定。方向性是RNS對血管損傷的影響。需要注意的是，來自 eNOS 的基礎 NO 具有保護性，因此疾病關聯取決於從偶聯源到非偶聯源或誘導源的轉變。這種轉變現在被認為是一種將高血糖、高血脂和 smoking 等經典危險因子與血管氧化損傷聯繫起來的統一機制。

context.en-US: Reactive nitrogen species contribute to diabetes mellitus because iNOS and NOX2 are upregulated in pancreatic islets, where peroxynitrite directly damages insulin-producing beta-cells. Nitrative stress thus links inflammation to beta-cell failure. The directionality is RNS to beta-cell injury. A caveat is that beta-cell loss in diabetes is multifactorial (autoimmunity, endoplasmic-reticulum stress, lipotoxicity), with RNS as one accelerating factor. Islet beta-cells are especially vulnerable because of low antioxidant capacity, so RNS-driven damage tips them toward dysfunction and apoptosis.
context.zh-TW: Reactive nitrogen species 對 diabetes mellitus 有貢獻，因為 iNOS 和 NOX2 在胰島中表達上調，其中 peroxynitrite 直接損害產生胰島素的 β 細胞。因此，Nitrative stress 將發炎與β細胞衰竭聯繫起來。方向性是 RNS 對 β 細胞損傷的影響。需要注意的是，糖尿病引起的 β 細胞損失是多因素造成的（自體免疫、內質網壓力、脂毒性），其中 RNS 是一個加速因素。由於抗氧化能力低，胰島β細胞特別脆弱，因此RNS驅動的損傷會使它們出現功能障礙和apoptosis。

context.en-US: Alpha-lipoic acid recycles glutathione by providing the reduced dihydrolipoic acid (DHLA) form, which directly reduces oxidized glutathione and also regenerates vitamins C and E. This restores the cellular thiol redox buffer and amplifies other antioxidants. The directionality is lipoate redox cycling to antioxidant network support. A caveat is that exogenous lipoic acid's in vivo recycling efficiency depends on tissue uptake and the endogenous reductase capacity. By maintaining the GSH pool, lipoic acid indirectly supports glutathione peroxidase, glutaredoxin, and glutathione S-transferase activity throughout the cell.
context.zh-TW: Alpha-lipoic acid 透過提供還原的二氫硫辛酸 (DHLA) 形式來回收 glutathione，直接還原氧化的 glutathione，並再生維生素 C 和 E。這會恢復細胞硫醇氧化還原緩衝液並放大其他 antioxidants。方向性是硫辛酸氧化還原循環至抗氧化網路支援。需要注意的是，外源硫辛酸的體內回收效率取決於組織吸收和內源性還原酶能力。透過維持 GSH 池，硫辛酸間接支持整個細胞內的 glutathione peroxidase、谷氧還蛋白和 glutathione S-轉移酶活性。

context.en-US: Alpha-lipoic acid scavenges hydroxyl radicals directly and also quenches singlet oxygen and hypochlorous acid, giving it broad-spectrum radical-trapping activity in both aqueous and lipid phases because it is amphipathic. Its dithiolane ring is the reactive center. The directionality is scavenger to radical neutralization. A caveat is that at high concentrations or in the oxidized form, lipoic acid's net antioxidant benefit can be modulated by redox cycling with other thiols. Both alpha-lipoic acid and its reduced form dihydrolipoic acid participate in these reactions, giving the pair redox flexibility in different cellular compartments.
context.zh-TW: Alpha-lipoic acid 直接清除 hydroxyl radicals，也猝滅 singlet oxygen 和 hypochlorous acid，由於它是兩親性的，因此在水相和脂相中都具有廣譜自由基捕獲活性。其二硫戊環為反應中心。方向性是激進中和的清道夫。需要注意的是，在高濃度或氧化形式下，硫辛酸的淨抗氧化功效可以透過與其他硫醇的氧化還原循環來調節。 alpha-lipoic acid 及其還原形式二氫硫辛酸都參與這些反應，使此對在不同的細胞區室中具有氧化還原靈活性。

context.en-US: Alpha-lipoic acid activates NRF2 by modifying reactive cysteine residues on Keap1, releasing NRF2 to translocate to the nucleus and induce antioxidant-response-element (ARE) genes. This upregulates phase-II enzymes and reinforces endogenous defense. The directionality is thiol modification to transcriptional antioxidant program. A caveat is that the magnitude of NRF2 activation in vivo is modest and context-dependent, and excessive activation could perturb normal redox signaling. This transcriptional upregulation of detoxifying and antioxidant enzymes is thought to contribute substantially to the compound's clinical antioxidant benefits.
context.zh-TW: Alpha-lipoic acid 透過修飾 Keap1 上的反應性半胱胺酸殘基活化 NRF2，釋放 NRF2 轉位至細胞核並誘導抗氧化反應元件 (ARE) 基因。這會上調 II 相酶並增強內源防禦。方向性是對轉錄抗氧化程序的硫醇修飾。需要注意的是，體內 NRF2 活化的程度是適度的並且依賴環境，過度活化可能會擾亂正常的氧化還原訊號傳導。這種解毒酶和抗氧化酶的轉錄上調被認為對該化合物的臨床抗氧化功效有重大貢獻。

context.en-US: Alpha-lipoic acid improves endothelial dysfunction, as confirmed in meta-analyses showing improved flow-mediated dilation and markers of oxidative stress in diabetic and metabolic patients. By restoring GSH and reducing NF-kappaB, it ameliorates NO bioavailability. The directionality is antioxidant supplementation to vascular benefit. A caveat is that trial results are heterogeneous and benefits are most consistent in established endothelial dysfunction rather than primary prevention. Lipoic acid also chelates redox-active metals, which may reduce the metal-catalyzed generation of hydroxyl radicals in the vascular wall.
context.zh-TW: 統合分析證實，Alpha-lipoic acid 改善了 endothelial dysfunction，顯示糖尿病和代謝患者中血流介導的擴張和 oxidative stress 標記得到改善。透過恢復 GSH 和減少 NF-κB，它可以改善 NO 的生物利用度。方向性是補充抗氧化劑對血管有益。需要注意的是，試驗結果有差異，在已建立的 endothelial dysfunction 而非一級預防中，效果最一致。硫辛酸也螯合 redox-active metals，這可能會減少血管壁中金屬催化的 hydroxyl radicals 的生成。

context.en-US: Alpha-lipoic acid inhibits NF-kappaB by preventing IkappaB phosphorylation and degradation, thereby limiting nuclear translocation of the transcription factor. This dampens downstream inflammatory cytokine production. The directionality is antioxidant to anti-inflammatory signaling suppression. A caveat is that NF-kappaB also has anti-apoptotic and protective roles, so chronic suppression could be deleterious in some contexts. This is relevant because NF-kappaB-driven cytokines in turn generate more ROS, so interrupting the loop at NF-kappaB is a rational antioxidant strategy.
context.zh-TW: Alpha-lipoic acid 透過阻止 IkappaB 磷酸化和降解來抑制 NF-kappaB，從而限制轉錄因子的核轉位。這抑制了下游發炎細胞因子的產生。方向性是抗氧化到抗發炎訊號傳導抑制。需要注意的是，NF-kappaB 還具有抗凋亡和保護作用，因此長期抑制在某些情況下可能是有害的。這是相關的，因為 NF-kappaB 驅動的細胞因子反過來產生更多的 ROS，因此中斷 NF-kappaB 的循環是一種合理的抗氧化策略。

context.en-US: Coenzyme Q10 transfers electrons between mitochondrial Complex I (or II) and Complex III as a mobile lipophilic carrier in the inner membrane, shuttling single electrons and buffering the pool. In its reduced form (ubiquinol) it also acts as an antioxidant. The directionality is electron transport coupled to redox buffering. A caveat is that CoQ10's electron-transfer role is distinct from its antioxidant role, and statin-mediated depletion can affect both. CoQ10 is synthesized endogenously via the mevalonate pathway and is also a potent lipophilic antioxidant in both its ubiquinol and ubiquinone forms.
context.zh-TW: Coenzyme Q10 作為內膜中的移動親脂載體在 mitochondrial Complex I（或 II）和複合物 III 之間轉移電子，穿梭單一電子並緩衝池。其還原形式（泛醇）也可作為抗氧化劑。方向性是與氧化還原緩衝耦合的電子傳遞。需要注意的是，CoQ10 的電子轉移作用與其抗氧化作用不同，而他汀類藥物介導的耗竭會影響這兩者。 CoQ10 透過甲羥戊酸途徑內源合成，其泛醇和泛醌形式也是一種有效的親脂性抗氧化劑。

context.en-US: Coenzyme Q10 protects against lipid peroxidation because ubiquinol reduces lipid peroxyl radicals in the bilayer, terminating chain reactions similarly to vitamin E. Its high concentration in membranes makes it a front-line chain breaker. The directionality is reduced CoQ10 to peroxyl radical termination. A caveat is that ubiquinol is rapidly consumed and must be regenerated enzymatically, so its protective capacity depends on the redox state of the CoQ pool. CoQ10 levels decline with age and in some pathologies, and supplementation is often used to restore membrane redox protection.
context.zh-TW: Coenzyme Q10 可防止 lipid peroxidation，因為泛醇可減少雙層中的脂質過氧自由基，從而終止與 vitamin E 類似的鍊式反應。它在膜中的高濃度使其成為一線的鏈條破壞者。方向性是 CoQ10 還原為過氧自由基終止。需要注意的是，泛醇會迅速消耗，必須透過酵素再生，因此其保護能力取決於 CoQ 池的氧化還原狀態。 CoQ10 水平隨著年齡的增長和某些疾病而下降，補充通常用於恢復膜的氧化還原保護。

context.en-US: Coenzyme Q10 regenerates vitamin E by reducing the alpha-tocopheroxyl radical back to alpha-tocopherol, extending the chain-breaking lifetime of vitamin E in membranes. This places CoQ10 upstream of vitamin E in the antioxidant network. The directionality is ubiquinol to tocopherol recycling. A caveat is that this regeneration competes with CoQ10's own peroxyl-radical scavenging, and the net effect depends on local ratios. The recycling interaction places CoQ10 and vitamin E as partners in a lipid-phase antioxidant network that also involves vitamin C at the membrane interface.
context.zh-TW: Coenzyme Q10 透過將 α-生育酚自由基還原回 α-生育醇來再生 vitamin E，從而延長了 vitamin E 在膜中的斷鏈壽命。這使得 CoQ10 在抗氧化網路中位於 vitamin E 的上游。方向性是泛醇到生育醇的回收。需要注意的是，這種再生與 CoQ10 自身的過氧自由基清除作用相競爭，淨效應取決於局部比率。這種回收相互作用將 CoQ10 和 vitamin E 作為脂相抗氧化網絡中的合作夥伴，該網絡還涉及膜界面上的維生素 C。

context.en-US: Statins reduce synthesis of Coenzyme Q10 because they inhibit HMG-CoA reductase, the upstream enzyme shared by the mevalonate pathway that produces both cholesterol and the isoprenoid side chain of CoQ10. This can lower tissue CoQ10 levels, particularly with high-dose or lipophilic statins. The directionality is enzyme inhibition to CoQ10 depletion. A caveat is that the clinical significance of statin-associated CoQ10 reduction is debated, with most patients not developing myopathy attributable to it.
context.zh-TW: Statins 減少 Coenzyme Q10 的合成，因為它們抑制 HMG-CoA 還原酶，該還原酶是甲羥戊酸途徑共有的上游酶，可產生 cholesterol 和 CoQ10 的類異戊二烯側鏈。這可以降低組織 CoQ10 水平，特別是使用高劑量或親脂性 statins 時。方向性是對 CoQ10 消耗的酵素抑制。需要注意的是，他汀類藥物相關的 CoQ10 減少的臨床意義存在爭議，大多數患者並未因此而患上肌肉病變。

context.en-US: Coenzyme Q10 reduces heart-failure morbidity and mortality, as suggested by the Q-SYMBIO trial showing a substantial reduction in major adverse cardiovascular events with supplementation in chronic heart failure. Its benefit is attributed to improved mitochondrial bioenergetics and reduced oxidative stress. The directionality is supplementation to improved cardiac outcomes. A caveat is that trial results are mixed and effect sizes vary, so CoQ10 is adjunctive rather than replacement therapy. Improved mitochondrial ATP production and endothelial function are also invoked to explain the cardiac benefit, though larger confirmatory trials are still needed.
context.zh-TW: Q-SYMBIO 試驗表明，Coenzyme Q10 可以降低心臟衰竭的發病率和死亡率，該試驗顯示，補充慢性 heart failure 後，主要不良反應 cardiovascular events 大幅減少。其益處歸因於改進的mitochondria1生物能學和減少的oxidative stress。方向性是改善心臟結果的補充。需要注意的是，試驗結果參差不齊，效果大小也各不相同，因此 CoQ10 是輔助療法，而不是替代療法。儘管仍需要更大規模的驗證性試驗，但改善的mitochondria1 ATP產生和內皮功能也被用來解釋心臟益處。

context.en-US: Endothelial dysfunction is caused by eNOS uncoupling, wherein insufficient tetrahydrobiopterin (BH4) or L-arginine leads eNOS to produce superoxide instead of NO, lowering bioavailable NO. This shifts the enzyme from vasoprotection to oxidative injury. The directionality is cofactor loss to dysfunction. A caveat is that endothelial dysfunction has many other drivers (shear stress, inflammation, hyperglycemia), so uncoupling is a major but not solitary mechanism. BH4 oxidation by peroxynitrite is a major driver of uncoupling, establishing a feed-forward loop in which early NO loss begets further superoxide generation.
context.zh-TW: Endothelial dysfunction是由eNOS解偶聯引起的，其中tetrahydrobiopterin(BH4)或L-arginine不足導致eNOS產生超氧化物而不是NO，從而降低生物可利用的NO。這使得酶從血管保護轉變為氧化損傷。方向性是輔助因子喪失導致功能障礙。需要注意的是，endothelial dysfunction 還有許多其他驅動因素（剪切應力、發炎、高血糖），因此解偶聯是一個主要但不是唯一的機制。 peroxynitrite 引起的 BH4 氧化是解偶聯的主要驅動因素，建立了一個前饋迴路，其中早期 NO 損失導致進一步的超氧化物生成。

context.en-US: Peroxynitrite oxidizes tetrahydrobiopterin (BH4) to BH2, depriving eNOS of its essential cofactor and thereby promoting eNOS uncoupling and superoxide production. This establishes a feed-forward loop of vascular oxidative stress. The directionality is nitration of cofactor to enzyme dysfunction. A caveat is that BH4 can be regenerated by dihydrofolate reductase, partially buffering peroxynitrite-driven loss. Restoring BH4 by supplementation or by dihydrofolate reductase-dependent recycling re-couples eNOS and improves endothelial function in experimental studies.
context.zh-TW: Peroxynitrite 將 tetrahydrobiopterin (BH4) 氧化為 BH2，剝奪 eNOS 的必需輔助因子，進而促進 eNOS 解偶聯和超氧化物產生。這就建立了血管oxidative stress的前饋迴路。方向性是輔因子硝化導致酵素功能障礙。需要注意的是，BH4 可以透過二氫葉酸還原酶再生，部分緩衝 peroxynitrite 驅動的損失。在實驗研究中，透過補充或二氫葉酸還原酶依賴性回收來恢復 BH4 可重新偶聯 eNOS 並改善內皮功能。

context.en-US: Uncoupled eNOS produces superoxide radicals when BH4 or L-arginine becomes limiting, causing the enzyme to redirect electron flow from NO synthesis to oxygen reduction. This converts the principal vascular protective enzyme into a ROS source. The directionality is cofactor deficiency to superoxide generation. A caveat is that partial uncoupling may still yield some NO, and the transition is graded rather than binary. This uncoupling is a central mechanism of endothelial dysfunction in hypertension, diabetes, and atherosclerosis, and therapies that restore BH4 or arginine aim to re-couple the enzyme.
context.zh-TW: 當 BH4 或 L-arginine 受到限制時，Uncoupled eNOS 會產生 superoxide radicals，導致酵素將電子流從 NO 合成重新導向到氧還原。這將主要的血管保護酶轉化為 ROS 源。方向性是超氧化物生成的輔因子缺乏。需要注意的是，部分解耦仍可能產生一些 NO，而且轉變是分級的而不是二元的。這種解偶聯是 endothelial dysfunction 在高血壓、糖尿病和 atherosclerosis 中的核心機制，恢復 BH4 或精氨酸的療法旨在重新偶聯該酶。

context.en-US: NADPH oxidase generates superoxide radicals in endothelial cells via NOX1 and NOX4 in response to angiotensin II and other stimuli, contributing to vascular oxidative stress. NOX4 additionally yields H2O2 that acts as a paracrine signal. The directionality is stimulus to endothelial ROS. A caveat is that endothelial NOX-derived ROS are also implicated in physiologic angiogenesis and barrier signaling at low levels. The balance between protective signaling and damaging stress therefore depends on the intensity and duration of NOX activation.
context.zh-TW: NADPH oxidase響應angiotensin II和其他刺激，透過NOX1和NOX4在內皮細胞中生成superoxide radicals，進而促成血管oxidative stress。 NOX4 也產生 H2O2，充當旁分泌訊號。方向性是對內皮ROS的刺激。需要注意的是，內皮 NOX 衍生的 ROS 也與低水平的生理血管生成和屏障訊號傳導有關。因此，保護訊號和 damaging 壓力之間的平衡取決於 NOX 活化的強度和持續時間。

context.en-US: ADMA inhibits eNOS by competitively occupying the L-arginine binding site of all NOS isoforms, reducing NO production and promoting uncoupling. Elevated ADMA (from reduced catabolism by dimethylarginine dimethylaminohydrolase) is a marker of endothelial risk. The directionality is endogenous inhibitor to NO deficiency. A caveat is that ADMA also inhibits other NOS isoforms and its effects are modulated by L-arginine availability and methyltransferase activity. Because ADMA is primarily cleared by DDAH, oxidative inactivation of DDAH raises ADMA and further suppresses NO, a self-reinforcing cycle in endothelial disease.
context.zh-TW: ADMA 透過競爭性佔據所有 NOS 亞型的 L-arginine 結合位點、減少 NO 產生並促進解偶聯來抑制 eNOS。 ADMA 升高（由於二甲基精氨酸二甲氨基水解酶分解代謝減少）是內皮風險的標誌。方向性是NO缺乏的內源性抑制劑。需要注意的是，ADMA 也抑制其他 NOS 亞型，其作用受到 L-arginine 可用性和甲基轉移酶活性的調節。由於 ADMA 主要由 DDAH 清除，DDAH 的氧化失活會升高 ADMA 並進一步抑制 NO（內皮疾病的自我強化循環）。

context.en-US: Phagocytes use the respiratory burst to produce high concentrations of ROS and RNS via NOX2 and inducible NOS, creating an antimicrobial environment in the phagosome and extracellular space. This oxidant surge kills engulfed pathogens but also risks collateral tissue damage. The directionality is immune activation to oxidant deployment. A caveat is that the burst is tightly compartmentalized and regulated; failure (CGD) causes infection, while excess causes inflammatory injury. The burst is also coordinated with phagosome maturation, degranulation, and acidification, ensuring oxidants act where pathogens are contained.
context.zh-TW: Phagocytes 使用 respiratory burst 透過 NOX2 和誘導型 NOS 產生高濃度的 ROS 和 RNS，在吞噬體和細胞外空間中創建抗菌環境 ironment。這種氧化激增會殺死被吞噬的病原體，但也有可能造成組織損傷。方向性是對氧化劑部署的免疫活化。需要注意的是，爆發是嚴格劃分和監管的。失敗（CGD）會導致感染，而過量則會導致發炎損傷。這種爆發也與吞噬體的成熟、脫粒和酸化相協調，確保氧化劑在病原體所在的地方發揮作用。

context.en-US: Myeloperoxidase converts hydrogen peroxide and chloride to hypochlorous acid (HOCl), the major bactericidal oxidant released by activated neutrophils. The enzyme uses heme to oxidize H2O2 while reducing chloride, concentrating HOCl in the phagolysosome and at infection sites. The directionality is peroxide plus halide to potent microbicide. A caveat is that HOCl is indiscriminately reactive and, when extracellular, damages host tissues and proteins such as alpha-1 antitrypsin.
