The specificity for chloride at physiological concentrations makes HOCl the dominant product of MPO catalysis in neutrophils.
context.zh-TW: Myeloperoxidase 將 hydrogen peroxide 和氯化物轉化為 hypochlorous acid (HOCl)，這是活化的中性粒細胞釋放的主要殺菌氧化劑。此酵素利用血紅素氧化 H2O2，同時還原氯，使 HOCl 濃縮在吞噬溶小體和感染部位。方向性是過氧化物加鹵化物到強效殺菌劑。需要注意的是，次氯酸具有不加區別的反應性，當在細胞外時，會損害宿主組織和 proteins，例如 alpha-1 antitrypsin。生理濃度下氯化物的特異性使得 HOCl 成為嗜中性球中 MPO 催化的主要產物。

context.en-US: Glutathione determines T cell polarization because the GSH/GSSG redox state tunes the balance between pro-inflammatory Th1/Th17 and anti-inflammatory Th2/Treg responses. Oxidized extracellular glutathione can itself act as a danger signal influencing differentiation. The directionality is thiol redox to immune phenotype. A caveat is that glutathione is one of several metabolic and cytokine inputs to T-cell fate, so it biases rather than dictates polarization. Redox modulation of T cells is therefore being investigated as an adjunctive target in autoimmunity and chronic inflammation.
context.zh-TW: Glutathione 決定 T cell polarization，因為 GSH/GSSG 氧化還原狀態調節促發炎 Th1/Th17 和抗發炎 Th2/Treg 反應之間的平衡。氧化的細胞外glutathione本身可以作為影響分化的危險訊號。方向性是硫醇氧化還原至免疫表型。需要注意的是，glutathione 是 T 細胞命運的幾種代謝和細胞激素輸入之一，因此它會產生偏見，而不是決定極化。因此，T 細胞的氧化還原調節正在作為自體免疫和慢性發炎的輔助標靶進行研究。

context.en-US: Reactive oxygen species activate NF-kappaB because oxidants (notably H2O2) modify cysteines on inhibitory proteins and upstream kinases, releasing NF-kappaB for nuclear translocation and target-gene expression. The transcription factor then induces genes that generate more ROS, establishing a feed-forward loop. The directionality is oxidant to transcriptional activation. A caveat is that ROS also activate many other pathways (MAPK, AP-1), and NF-kappaB can be either protective or pathogenic depending on context.
context.zh-TW: Reactive oxygen species 活化 NF-kappaB，因為氧化劑（特別是 H2O2）會修飾抑制性 proteins 和上游激酶上的半胱氨酸，釋放 NF-kappaB 用於核轉位和目標基因表現。然後轉錄因子誘導產生更多 ROS 的基因，建立前饋循環。方向性是轉錄活化的氧化劑。需要注意的是，ROS 還激活許多其他途徑（MAPK、AP-1），並且 NF-kappaB 根據具體情況可以具有保護性或致病性。

context.en-US: NF-kappaB induces TNF-alpha along with over 500 other target genes, driving the pro-inflammatory cascade that amplifies oxidative and immune responses. This positions NF-kappaB upstream of a cytokine network central to inflammation. The directionality is transcription factor to cytokine output. A caveat is that TNF-alpha itself further activates NF-kappaB, so the relationship is reciprocally reinforcing rather than linear. This circuit is central to chronic inflammatory diseases, and interrupting it with TNF blockade reduces both inflammatory and oxidative burden in treated patients.
context.zh-TW: NF-kappaB 誘導 TNF-alpha 以及 500 多個其他目標基因，驅動促炎級聯反應，從而放大氧化和免疫反應。這將 NF-kappaB 定位在發炎核心細胞因子網絡的上游。方向性是轉錄因子到細胞激素的輸出。需要注意的是，TNF-alpha 本身會進一步活化 NF-kappaB，因此這種關係是相互增強的，而不是線性的。此迴路是慢性發炎性疾病的核心，透過 TNF 阻斷來中斷此迴路可減少治療患者的發炎和氧化負擔。

context.en-US: NF-kappaB antagonizes NRF2 through mutual competition, as the RelA subunit competes with NRF2 for the coactivators CBP and p300, limiting antioxidant gene transcription. This creates a molecular switch that favors inflammation over antioxidant defense. The directionality is transcriptional competition suppressing the antioxidant program. A caveat is that cross-talk is context-dependent and certain stimuli can co-activate both pathways transiently. Drugs and phytochemicals that boost NRF2 therefore tend to dampen NF-kappaB responses, an interplay exploited in anti-inflammatory therapy.
context.zh-TW: NF-kappaB 透過相互競爭拮抗 NRF2，因為 RelA 亞基與 NRF2 競爭共活化劑 CBP 和 p300，從而限制抗氧化基因轉錄。這就產生了一種分子開關，有利於發炎而不是抗氧化防禦。方向性是抑制抗氧化程序的轉錄競爭。需要注意的是，cross-talk 是依賴情境的，某些刺激可以短暫地共同活化這兩種途徑。因此，促進 NRF2 的藥物和植物化學物質往往會抑制 NF-κB 反應，這是抗發炎治療中利用的交互作用。

context.en-US: A20 terminates NF-kappaB signaling by removing K63-linked ubiquitin chains from RIP1 and TRAF6, thereby shutting down IKK activation and the downstream cascade. As a feedback inhibitor, A20 limits excessive inflammation and tissue damage. The directionality is deubiquitination to signal termination. A caveat is that A20 mutations or insufficiency are linked to chronic inflammatory and autoimmune diseases, showing its role is non-redundant in some tissues. Mice lacking A20 in specific tissues develop severe spontaneous inflammation, confirming its role as an essential inflammatory brake.
context.zh-TW: A20 透過從 RIP1 和 TRAF6 中移除 K63 連接的泛素鏈來終止 NF-kappaB 訊號傳導，從而關閉 IKK 活化和下游級聯。作為反饋抑制劑，A20 可以限制過度發炎和組織損傷。方向性是去泛素化到訊號終止。需要注意的是，A20 突變或不足與慢性發炎和自體免疫疾病有關，這表明​​它的作用在某些組織中是非冗餘的。特定組織中缺乏 A20 的小鼠會出現嚴重的自發性炎症，證實了其作為重要發炎制動劑的作用。

context.en-US: S-nitrosylation inhibits NF-kappaB when NO-derived S-nitrosothiols modify key cysteines (p50 Cys-62 and RelA Cys-38), disrupting DNA binding and transcriptional activity. This provides a redox-based brake on inflammatory signaling. The directionality is NO-mediated modification to transcriptional repression. A caveat is that the effect is reversible and concentration-dependent, and high NO can also paradoxically promote NF-kappaB under some conditions. This mechanism contributes to NO's ability to restrain inflammatory gene expression and may explain some anti-inflammatory actions of nitrosating agents.
context.zh-TW: 當 NO 衍生的 S-nitrosothiols 修飾關鍵半胱氨酸（p50 Cys-62 和 RelA Cys-38）時，S-nitrosylation 會抑制 NF-kappaB，從而破壞 DNA 結合和轉錄活性。这提供了基于氧化还原的炎症信号传导制动。方向性是 NO 介導的轉錄抑制修飾。需要注意的是，该效应是可逆的且依赖于浓度，并且在某些条件下，高 NO 也会相反地促进 NF-κB。这种机制有助于 NO 抑制 inflammatory gene expression 的能力，并可能解释 nitrosating 药物的一些抗炎作用。

context.en-US: Bortezomib blocks NF-kappaB by inhibiting the proteasome, preventing degradation of IkappaB and thus trapping NF-kappaB in the cytoplasm. This therapeutic strategy exploits the dependence of many cancers on NF-kappaB survival signaling. The directionality is proteasome inhibition to transcriptional blockade. A caveat is that bortezomib also inhibits degradation of many other proteins, causing toxicity such as peripheral neuropathy. The drug is used in multiple myeloma and mantle-cell lymphoma, where its NF-kappaB blockade and proteotoxic stress together induce myeloma cell death.
context.zh-TW: Bortezomib 透過抑制蛋白酶體來阻斷 NF-kappaB，防止 IkappaB 降解，從而將 NF-kappaB 捕獲在細胞質中。這種治療策略利用了許多 cancer 對 NF-kappaB 生存訊號的依賴。方向性是蛋白酶體抑制轉錄阻斷。需要注意的是，bortezomib 也會抑制許多其他 proteins 的降解，進而導致周邊神經病變等毒性。該藥物用於治療多發性骨髓瘤和套細胞淋巴瘤，其 NF-kappaB 阻斷和蛋白毒性壓力共同誘導骨髓瘤細胞死亡。

context.en-US: Nitrative stress is caused by reactive nitrogen species when RNS production exceeds the capacity of detoxifying and repair systems to neutralize them. The condition reflects an imbalance between nitrating oxidants and endogenous defenses. The directionality is RNS excess to nitrative damage. A caveat is that transient, localized RNS signaling is physiological, so pathology depends on chronic overload or miscompartmentalization. The transition from beneficial to pathological RNS activity hinges on concentration, duration, and the tissue's antioxidant and repair capacity.
context.zh-TW: Nitrative stress 是由 reactive nitrogen species 當 RNS 產生超過解毒和修復系統中和它們的能力時引起的。這種情況反映了硝化氧化劑和內源性防禦之間的不平衡。方向性是RNS過量對硝化損傷的影響。需要注意的是，短暫的、局部的 RNS 訊號傳導是生理性的，因此病理學取決於慢性超負荷或錯室化。 RNS 活性從有益到病理的轉變取決於濃度、持續時間以及組織的抗氧化和修復能力。

context.en-US: Peroxynitrite is the key mediator of nitrative stress, formed at diffusion-limited rates from the reaction of nitric oxide with superoxide and responsible for the majority of tyrosine nitration observed in disease. Its centrality distinguishes it from other, less abundant RNS. The directionality is hybrid oxidant to the dominant nitrative lesion. A caveat is that other oxidants (e.g., myeloperoxidase-derived) also contribute to nitration, so peroxynitrite is the major but not sole mediator. Its role is supported by the colocalization of nitrotyrosine with peroxynitrite-generating cells in inflamed and degenerating tissues.
context.zh-TW: Peroxynitrite 是 nitrative stress 的關鍵介體，由 nitric oxide 與超氧化物反應以擴散限制速率形成，並負責疾病中觀察到的大部分 tyrosine 硝化。它的中心地位使其有別於其他數量較少的 RNS。方向性是主要硝化損傷的混合氧化劑。需要注意的是，其他氧化劑（例如 myeloperoxidase 衍生的）也有助於硝化，因此 peroxynitrite 是主要但不是唯一的介體。發炎和退化組織中硝基rosine 與peroxynitrite 生成細胞的共定位支持了其作用。

context.en-US: 3-nitrotyrosine is the most characteristic modification of nitrative stress, elevated in over fifty human pathologies as a stable footprint of protein tyrosine nitration. Its presence is used experimentally to infer peroxynitrite or related RNS activity. The directionality is nitrative insult to stable adduct. A caveat is that 3-nitrotyrosine can be generated by multiple nitrating pathways and can be repaired or turned over, so it marks historical rather than acute stress. Detection in exhaled breath condensate and urine is increasingly used to monitor nitrative burden non-invasively in lung and systemic disease.
context.zh-TW: 3-nitrotyrosine 是 nitrative stress 最具特徵性的修飾，在 50 多種人類病理中作為蛋白質 tyrosine 硝化的穩定足跡而升高。它的存在被實驗性地用來推論 peroxynitrite 或相關的 RNS 活性。方向性是對穩定加合物的硝化損害。需要注意的是，3-nitrotyrosine 可以透過多種硝化途徑產生，並且可以修復或翻轉，因此它標誌著歷史壓力，而不是急性壓力。呼出氣冷凝物和尿液的檢測越來越多地用於非侵入性監測肺部和全身疾病的硝態負荷。

context.en-US: Peroxynitrite inactivates aconitase by disrupting its [4Fe-4S] cluster, impairing the TCA-cycle enzyme and diverting citrate metabolism. This links nitrative stress to mitochondrial metabolic dysfunction. The directionality is cluster destruction to enzyme inactivation. A caveat is that aconitase is also sensitive to superoxide and other oxidants, so its inhibition is not uniquely peroxynitrite-driven. Because aconitase also acts as iron regulatory protein 1 when its cluster is lost, oxidative inactivation links metabolic and iron-regulatory responses.
context.zh-TW: Peroxynitrite 透過破壞 aconitase 的 [4Fe-4S] 簇、損害 TCA 循環酶並轉移檸檬酸代謝來滅活 aconitase。這將 nitrative stress 與 mitochondria1 代謝功能障礙聯繫起來。方向性是簇破壞到酵素失活。需要注意的是，aconitase 也對超氧化物和其他氧化劑敏感，因此它的抑製作用並不是 peroxynitrite 獨有的。由於 aconitase 在其簇丟失時也充當 iron 調節蛋白 1，因此氧化失活將代謝和 iron 調節反應聯繫起來。

context.en-US: Nitrated lipids activate PPARgamma, as electrophilic nitrated fatty acids such as nitrolinoleic acid act as ligands that promote the receptor's transcriptional program. This redirects metabolism and induces anti-inflammatory and antioxidant genes. The directionality is lipid nitration product to nuclear receptor activation. A caveat is that nitrated lipids can also signal through PPARalpha and other targets, so PPARgamma is a major but not exclusive node. This pathway represents a feedback mechanism in which nitrative stress generates endogenous ligands that dampen inflammation.
context.zh-TW: Nitrated lipids 活化 PPARgamma，因為硝基亞麻油酸等親電子硝化脂肪酸充當配體，促進受體的轉錄程序。這會改變新陳代謝並誘導抗炎和抗氧化基因。方向性是脂質硝化產物對核受體的活化。需要注意的是，nitrated lipids 還可以透過 PPARalpha 和其他目標發出訊號，因此 PPARgamma 是一個主要但不是唯一的節點。該通路代表了一種反饋機制，其中 nitrative stress 生成抑制發炎的內源性配體。

context.en-US: Amyloid-beta binds redox-active metals (Cu2+ and Fe3+), forming complexes that generate superoxide and H2O2 via Fenton-like chemistry at the metal site. This positions Abeta as a localized source of ROS in the Alzheimer brain. The directionality is metal binding to radical generation. A caveat is that metal-free Abeta aggregation also drives pathology, so redox activity is one of several toxic functions. Abeta is proposed to act as a redox-active metal chaperone, and metal chelators have been tested as candidate therapies to limit this pro-oxidant activity.
context.zh-TW: β 澱粉樣蛋白與 redox-active metals（Cu2+ 和 Fe3+）結合，形成複合物，透過金屬位點上的類芬頓化學反應生成超氧化物和 H2O2。這使得 Abeta 成為阿茲海默症大腦中 ROS 的局部來源。方向性是金属与自由基生成的结合。需要注意的是，不含金屬的 Abeta 聚集也會引發病理學，因此氧化還原活性是多種毒性功能之一。 Abeta 被提议充当氧化还原活性金属伴侣，金属螯合剂已作为限制这种促氧化活性的候选疗法进行了测试。

context.en-US: Dopamine undergoes autoxidation, a spontaneous oxidation in which dopamine quinones, superoxide, H2O2, and 6-hydroxydopamine are produced, especially at physiological pH. This creates ROS in dopaminergic neurons independent of external insults. The directionality is catecholamine oxidation to oxidant and quinone formation. A caveat is that autoxidation is accelerated by metal ions and pH, and the quinones also form adducts that may be more directly toxic than the radicals. In Parkinson's disease, the resulting oxidant and quinone stress is thought to contribute to the selective vulnerability of dopaminergic substantia nigra neurons.
context.zh-TW: Dopamine 經歷 autoxidation，這是一種自發性氧化，其中產生 dopamine 醌、超氧化物、H2O2 和 6-羥基dopamine，特別是在生理 pH 條件下。这在 dopaminergic 神经元中创建了 ROS，不受外部刺激的影响。方向性是儿茶酚胺氧化成氧化剂并形成醌。需要注意的是，金屬離子和 pH 值會加速 autoxidation 的生成，而醌也會形成可能比自由基更直接毒性的加合物。在 Parkinson's disease 中，由此产生的氧化剂和醌应激被认为导致了 dopaminergic 黑质神经元的选择性脆弱性。

context.en-US: Mitochondrial Complex I activity is reduced (about 30 to 40 percent) in the substantia nigra of Parkinson's disease patients, contributing to electron leak and superoxide generation. This localized respiratory defect is among the earliest bioenergetic abnormalities described in PD. The directionality is enzyme deficiency to increased mitochondrial ROS. A caveat is that Complex I inhibition can be both a cause and a consequence of oxidative damage, and not all PD cases show the same magnitude of defect.
context.zh-TW: Parkinson's disease 患者黑質中的 Mitochondrial Complex I 活性降低（約 30% 至 40%），導致電子洩漏和超氧化物生成。這種局部呼吸缺陷是帕金森氏症中最早被描述的生物能異常之一。方向性是酵素缺乏導致mitochondrial ROS增加。需要注意的是，複合物 I 抑制既可能是氧化損傷的原因，也可能是氧化損傷的結果，並且並非所有 PD 病例都表現出相同程度的缺陷。

context.en-US: Oxidative stress promotes tau hyperphosphorylation by activating kinases such as GSK-3beta and CDK5 that phosphorylate tau and reduce its binding to microtubules. Excess oxidative modification thereby shifts tau toward a detached, aggregation-prone state. The directionality is oxidant to kinase activation to tau modification. A caveat is that tau phosphorylation is also tightly regulated by phosphatases, and some phosphorylation is physiological, so oxidative stress modulates rather than solely dictates the process.
context.zh-TW: Oxidative stress 透過活化 GSK-3beta 和 CDK5 等激酶（使 tau 磷酸化並減少其與微管的結合）來促進 tau 過度磷酸化。過度的氧化修飾從而使 tau 轉向分離的、易於聚集的狀態。方向性是氧化劑對激酶活化對tau修飾。需要注意的是，tau 磷酸化也受到磷酸酶的嚴格調節，並且一些磷酸化是生理性的，因此 oxidative stress 調節而不是僅僅決定該過程。

context.en-US: MitoQ reduces mitochondrial ROS as a mitochondria-targeted ubiquinone derivative that accumulates in the matrix and chain-breaks peroxyl radicals at their source. By concentrating antioxidant capacity inside mitochondria, it limits the downstream damage from leaked electrons. The directionality is targeted antioxidant to lowered mitochondrial oxidant burden. A caveat is that high doses of MitoQ can accumulate and potentially act as a pro-oxidant by virtue of its redox-cycling quinone structure. MitoQ has shown benefit in models of ischemia-reperfusion, neurodegeneration, and age-related vascular dysfunction.
context.zh-TW: MitoQ 將 mitochondrial ROS 還原為 mitochondria 靶向泛醌衍生物，該衍生物在基質中積累，並在其源頭斷鏈過氧自由基。透過將抗氧化能力集中在 mitochondria 內部，它限制了洩漏電子對下游的損害。方向性是靶向抗氧化劑以降低mitochondria1氧化劑負荷。需要注意的是，高劑量的 MitoQ 可能會積累，並可能因其氧化還原循環醌結構而充當促氧化劑。 MitoQ 在缺血再灌注、neurodegeneration 和年齡相關血管功能障礙模型中顯示出益處。

context.en-US: Hydrogen peroxide acts as a signaling molecule, functioning as a second messenger in insulin signaling, growth-factor pathways, and immune responses. Its relatively long half-life and membrane permeability allow it to diffuse and oxidize specific targets reversibly. The directionality is H2O2 from enzyme or leak to signal propagation. A caveat is that the same molecule is toxic at higher concentrations, so concentration and compartmentalization determine whether H2O2 signals or damages. Reversible oxidation of target cysteines, such as those in PTP1B and PTEN, allows H2O2 to propagate kinase-dependent responses.
context.zh-TW: Hydrogen peroxide 作為訊號分子，在胰島素訊號、生長因子途徑和免疫反應中充當第二信使。其相對較長的半衰期和膜滲透性使其能夠可逆地擴散和氧化特定標靶。方向性是 H2O2 從酵素或洩漏到訊號傳播。需要注意的是，相同的分子在較高濃度下是有毒的，因此濃度和區室化決定了 H2O2 是否發出訊號或造成損害。目標半胱氨酸（例如 PTP1B 和 PTEN 中的半胱氨酸）的可逆氧化使 H2O2 能夠傳播激酶依賴性反應。

context.en-US: Hydrogen peroxide oxidizes cysteine thiols, transducing signals through reversible oxidation to sulfenic acid, disulfide, or higher oxides that alter protein activity. This post-translational modification is a core mechanism by which oxidants regulate phosphatases, kinases, and transcription factors. The directionality is oxidant to thiol modification to functional change. A caveat is that excessive or irreversible over-oxidation (sulfinic/sulfonic acid) leads to loss of function and damage rather than signaling.
context.zh-TW: Hydrogen peroxide 氧化 cysteine thiols，透過可逆氧化將訊號轉化成次磺酸、二硫化物或改變蛋白質活性的高級氧化物。這種翻譯後修飾是氧化劑調節磷酸酶、激酶和轉錄因子的核心機制。方向性是氧化劑到硫醇修飾到功能變化。需要注意的是，過度或不可逆的過度氧化（亞磺酸/磺酸）會導致功能喪失和損傷，而不是訊號傳導。

context.en-US: Protein tyrosine phosphatases are inactivated by hydrogen peroxide because their catalytic cysteines (e.g., PTP1B Cys-215) are oxidized to sulfenic acid, blocking substrate dephosphorylation. This shifts the phosphorylation balance toward active kinase signaling, notably in insulin and growth-factor pathways. The directionality is H2O2 to reversible PTP inhibition to enhanced phosphorylation. A caveat is that sustained oxidation can progress to irreversible inactivation and that some phosphatases are less redox-sensitive, adding specificity.
context.zh-TW: Protein tyrosine phosphatases 被 hydrogen peroxide 滅活，因為它們的催化半胱氨酸（例如 PTP1B Cys-215）被氧化為次磺酸，從而阻止底物去磷酸化。這將磷酸化平衡轉向活性激酶訊號傳導，特別是在胰島素和生長因子途徑中。方向性是 H2O2 到可逆 PTP 抑製到增強磷酸化。需要注意的是，持續氧化可能會發展為不可逆的失活，某些磷酸酶對氧化還原較不敏感，從而增加了特異性。

context.en-US: Nitric oxide activates soluble guanylyl cyclase by binding the ferrous heme of the enzyme, stimulating cGMP production up to roughly 200-fold. The cGMP second messenger then drives vasodilation, platelet inhibition, and neuronal signaling. The directionality is NO to heme activation to cGMP cascade. A caveat is that NO scavenging by superoxide to form peroxynitrite diverts NO away from sGC, so the response depends on the local redox environment. Phosphodiesterase-5 inhibitors prolong this signal by slowing cGMP breakdown, which is why they are effective in erectile dysfunction and pulmonary hypertension.
context.zh-TW: Nitric oxide 透過結合酶的亞鐵血紅素來活化 soluble guanylyl cyclase，刺激 cGMP 產量高達約 200 倍。然後，cGMP 第二信使驅動 vasodilation、血小板抑制和神經元訊號傳導。血紅素活化和 cGMP 級聯的方向性是「否」。需要注意的是，超氧化物清除 NO 形成 peroxynitrite 會將 NO 從 sGC 轉移出去，因此反應取決於局部氧化還原 environment。磷酸二酯酶 5 抑制劑透過減緩 cGMP 分解來延長此訊號，這就是它們對勃起功能障礙和肺動脈高壓有效的原因。

context.en-US: PTEN is oxidized by hydrogen peroxide at Cys-124, which inactivates this lipid phosphatase and thereby sustains Akt activation and survival signaling. This exemplifies redox tuning of a major tumor-suppressor node. The directionality is H2O2 to PTEN oxidation to Akt hyperactivation. A caveat is that PTEN oxidation is often reversible, and chronic oxidation or additional modifications could instead promote instability, so context matters. This redox switch is exploited by growth-factor signaling, where transient H2O2 bursts transiently relieve the PTEN-mediated brake on PI3K/Akt.
context.zh-TW: PTEN 在 Cys-124 處被 hydrogen peroxide 氧化，從而使此脂質磷酸酶失去活性，從而維持 Akt 活化和生存訊號傳導。這例證了主要腫瘤抑制節點的氧化還原調節。方向性是 H2O2 到 PTEN 氧化到 Akt 過度活化。需要注意的是，PTEN 氧化通常是可逆的，慢性氧化或額外的修飾可能反而會促進不穩定，因此背景很重要。這種氧化還原開關被生長因子訊號傳導所利用，其中瞬時的 H2O2 爆發會暫時緩解 PTEN 介導的對 PI3K/Akt 的抑制。

context.en-US: Xanthine oxidase catalyzes the conversion of hypoxanthine to xanthine and xanthine to uric acid, using molecular oxygen as the electron acceptor. This enzyme thus sits at the junction of purine catabolism and ROS production. The directionality is purine oxidation to urate plus superoxide generation. A caveat is that the enzyme exists in an NAD+-dependent dehydrogenase form (XDH) that, when converted to the oxidase form (XO), becomes the prominent ROS-producing variant. The reaction also generates superoxide and hydrogen peroxide when oxygen serves as the electron acceptor, coupling urate production to oxidant release.
context.zh-TW: Xanthine oxidase 使用分子氧作為電子受體催化次黃嘌呤轉化為黃嘌呤以及黃嘌呤轉化為 uric acid。因此，此酵素位於嘌呤分解代謝和 ROS 生產的結合點。方向性是嘌呤氧化為尿酸鹽加上超氧化物的生成。需要注意的是，該酶以 NAD+ 依賴性脫氫酶形式 (XDH) 存在，當轉換為氧化酶形式 (XO) 時，它會成為主要的 ROS 生成變體。當氧氣作為電子受體時，此反應也會產生超氧化物和 hydrogen peroxide，從而將尿酸鹽的產生與氧化劑的釋放耦合。

context.en-US: Xanthine oxidase produces superoxide radicals because, as it oxidizes hypoxanthine and xanthine, it transfers electrons to molecular oxygen rather than NAD+, yielding O2-*. This makes XO a significant extra-mitochondrial ROS source, especially in endothelium. The directionality is enzyme catalysis to superoxide formation. A caveat is that the oxidase/dehydrogenase ratio is regulated post-translationally, so superoxide output varies with the enzyme's conformation and redox state. XO activity rises during ischemia and inflammation, making it a target for drugs such as allopurinol that suppress both urate and ROS.
context.zh-TW: Xanthine oxidase 產生 superoxide radicals，因為當它氧化次黃嘌呤和黃嘌呤時，它將電子轉移到分子氧而不是 NAD+，產生 O2-*。這使得 XO 成為重要的額外 mitochondrial ROS 來源，尤其是在內皮細胞中。方向性是酵素催化超氧化物的形成。需要注意的是，氧化酶/脫氫酶的比例是在翻譯後調節的，因此超氧化物輸出隨酶的構象和氧化還原狀態而變化。 XO 活性在缺血和發炎期間升高，使其成為抑制尿酸鹽和 ROS 等藥物的標靶。

context.en-US: Xanthine oxidase causes ischemia-reperfusion injury because, upon reperfusion, accumulated hypoxanthine meets newly available oxygen and XO generates a burst of superoxide and H2O2. This oxidant surge, together with neutrophil and mitochondrial ROS, amplifies tissue damage after blood return. The directionality is reperfusion to XO activation to injury. A caveat is that XO is one of several sources in reperfusion, and ischemic priming also contributes independently. Preclinical and some clinical studies show that XO inhibition before reperfusion attenuates infarct size and endothelial damage.
context.zh-TW: Xanthine oxidase 導致 ischemia-reperfusion injury，因為再灌注時，累積的次黃嘌呤遇到新可用的氧氣，XO 會產生大量超氧化物和 H2O2。這種氧化劑激增與嗜中性球和 mitochondrial ROS 一起，在血液回流後放大了組織損傷。方向性是再灌注到 XO 活化到損傷。需要注意的是，XO 是再灌注的幾個來源之一，缺血啟動也有獨立的影響。臨床前和一些臨床研究表明，再灌注前抑制 XO 可減輕梗塞面積和內皮損傷。

context.en-US: Allopurinol inhibits xanthine oxidase, as allopurinol and its active metabolite oxypurinol competitively bind the molybdenum center and block purine oxidation. Clinically this lowers uric acid and also curbs XO-derived superoxide. The directionality is competitive inhibition to reduced urate and ROS. A caveat is that allopurinol inhibits the dehydrogenase and oxidase forms differently and can cause hypersensitivity in some patients, notably those with HLA-B*58:01. Beyond gout, allopurinol has been studied for cardiovascular protection, chronic kidney disease progression, and prevention of tumor lysis syndrome.
context.zh-TW: Allopurinol 抑制 xanthine oxidase，因为 allopurinol 及其活性代谢物奥昔嘌呤醇竞争性结合钼中心并阻止嘌呤氧化。临床上，这会降低 uric acid 并抑制 XO 衍生的超氧化物。方向性是对还原尿酸盐和ROS的竞争性抑制。需要注意的是，allopurinol 以不同的方式抑制脫氫酶和氧化酶的形成，並可能在某些患者中引起過敏，尤其是 HLA-B*58:01 患者。除了痛风之外，allopurinol 还被研究用于心血管保护、慢性肾病进展和预防肿瘤溶解综合征。

context.en-US: Xanthine oxidase reduces nitric oxide under hypoxia by functioning as a nitrate reductase that produces NO when nitric oxide synthase is inactive. This provides an alternative, oxygen-independent source of vasodilatory NO during low oxygen. The directionality is XO-driven nitrate reduction to NO formation. A caveat is that under normoxia XO predominantly produces superoxide, so this NO-generating role is context- and oxygen-dependent. The dual roles of XO as NO producer under hypoxia and superoxide source under normoxia make its inhibition context-dependent in vascular biology.
context.zh-TW: Xanthine oxidase 在缺氧條件下透過充當硝酸還原酶來還原 nitric oxide，當 nitric oxide synthase 不活躍時，此硝酸還原酶會產生 NO。這提供了低氧期間血管舒張一氧化氮的替代、不依賴氧氣的來源。方向性是 XO 驅動的硝酸鹽還原成 NO 的形成。需要注意的是，在含氧量正常的情況下，XO 主要產生超氧化物，因此這種 NO 生成作用取決於環境和氧氣。 XO 在缺氧條件下作為 NO 產生者和在常氧條件下作為超氧化物源的雙重作用使其抑制在血管生物學中具有背景依賴性。

context.en-US: Febuxostat inhibits xanthine oxidase as a non-purine, selective inhibitor that blocks both the oxidized and reduced forms of the enzyme. Compared with allopurinol it achieves more complete suppression of urate production. The directionality is enzyme inhibition to lower urate and less XO-derived ROS. A caveat is that febuxostat carries cardiovascular black-box warnings in some populations and, like allopurinol, does not address pre-existing urate crystal deposits immediately. Febuxostat is primarily metabolized by the liver, allowing use in some renally impaired patients, although cardiovascular safety warnings limit broad adoption.
context.zh-TW: Febuxostat 作為一種非嘌呤選擇性抑制劑抑制 xanthine oxidase，可阻斷此酵素的氧化形式和還原形式。與allopurinol相比，實現了更徹底的尿酸鹽生成抑制。方向性是酵素抑制，以降低尿酸和減少 XO 衍生的 ROS。需要注意的是，febuxostat 在某些人群中帶有心血管黑盒警告，並且與 allopurinol 一樣，不能立即解決預先存在的尿酸鹽晶體沉積物。 Febuxostat 主要由肝臟代謝，允許在一些腎功能不全的患者中使用，儘管心血管安全警告限制了廣泛採用。

context.en-US: ABCA1 regulates cholesterol homeostasis by mediating the efflux of cellular cholesterol and phospholipids to lipid-poor apolipoproteins such as apoA-I. This is the first step in reverse cholesterol transport and HDL biogenesis. The directionality is transporter activity to lipid export. A caveat is that ABCA1 also influences phospholipid trafficking and immune cell function, so its role extends beyond pure cholesterol handling. Loss of ABCA1 function underlies Tangier disease, and its deficiency in macrophages promotes foam-cell formation and accelerated atherosclerosis.
context.zh-TW: ABCA1 透過介導細胞 cholesterol 和磷脂質向脂質貧乏的 apolipoproteins（例如 apoA-I）的流出來調節 cholesterol homeostasis。這是reverse cholesterol transport和HDL生物發生的第一步。方向性是脂質輸出的轉運蛋白活性。需要注意的是，ABCA1 也影響磷脂運輸和免疫細胞功能，因此其作用超出了純粹的 cholesterol 處理範圍。 ABCA1 功能的喪失是 Tangier disease 的基礎，巨噬細胞中的 ABCA1 功能缺失會促進泡沫細胞的形成並加速 atherosclerosis。

context.en-US: ABCA1 prevents atherosclerosis by driving cholesterol efflux from macrophages, which limits foam-cell formation and arterial lipid accumulation. Loss of this reverse-transport step tips the vessel wall toward retention of cholesterol. The directionality is efflux to reduced plaque initiation. A caveat is that ABCA1 is one of several anti-atherogenic mechanisms (e.g., ABCG1, SR-BI), so its deficiency increases but does not solely determine risk. ABCA1 expression is induced by LXR agonists, which are being explored as therapies that harness reverse cholesterol transport to retard plaque formation.
context.zh-TW: ABCA1 透過驅動 cholesterol 從巨噬細胞流出來阻止 atherosclerosis，從而限制泡沫細胞的形成和動脈脂質累積。失去這個反向運輸步驟會使血管壁傾向於保留 cholesterol。方向性是流出以減少斑塊的形成。需要注意的是，ABCA1 是多種抗動脈粥狀硬化機制（例如 ABCG1、SR-BI）之一，因此其缺陷會增加，但並不僅僅決定風險。 ABCA1 表達由 LXR 激動劑誘導，目前正在探索如何利用 reverse cholesterol transport 來延緩斑塊形成的療法。

context.en-US: ABCA1 is regulated by LXRalpha, as the nuclear receptor directly drives ABCA1 transcription in response to oxysterol ligands, coordinating cholesterol efflux. This places ABCA1 downstream of LXR-controlled reverse-cholesterol-transport programs. The directionality is LXRalpha activation to ABCA1 expression. A caveat is that PPARgamma and other transcription factors also regulate ABCA1, so LXRalpha is a major but not exclusive controller. This LXR-ABCA1 axis is also redox-responsive, since oxidative modifications of LDL generate LXR ligands that upregulate the transporter as a protective response.
context.zh-TW: ABCA1 受 LXRalpha 調節，因為核受體響應氧甾醇配體直接驅動 ABCA1 轉錄，協調 cholesterol 流出。這將 ABCA1 置於 LXR 控制的反向 cholesterol 傳輸程式的下游。方向性是LXRalpha活化至ABCA1表達。需要注意的是，PPARgamma 和其他轉錄因子也調節 ABCA1，因此 LXRalpha 是主要但不是唯一的控制者。此 LXR-ABCA1 軸也具有氧化還原反應性，因為 LDL 的氧化修飾會產生 LXR 配體，從而上調轉運蛋白作為保護性反應。

context.en-US: ABCA1 mutations cause Tangier disease, a rare disorder in which loss-of-function ABCA1 alleles lead to extremely low HDL and accumulation of cholesteryl esters in macrophages and other tissues. The defect blocks cholesterol efflux, producing enlarged orange tonsils and neuropathy. The directionality is transporter loss to lipid accumulation. A caveat is that incomplete versus complete loss of function yields a spectrum of severity, and modifier genes influence phenotype. Heterozygotes show intermediate HDL reduction, illustrating a gene-dosage effect and the clinical spectrum between Tangier disease and familial HDL deficiency.
context.zh-TW: ABCA1 mutations 導致 Tangier disease，這是一種罕見的疾病，其中 ABCA1 等位基因功能喪失導致 HDL 極低以及巨噬細胞和其他組織中膽固醇酯的累積。此缺陷阻礙了 cholesterol 的流出，導致橙色扁桃體增大和神經病變。方向性是轉運蛋白損失導致脂質累積。需要注意的是，不完全與完全功能喪失會產生一系列嚴重程度，且修飾基因會影響表型。雜合子表現出中等程度的 HDL 降低，說明了基因劑量效應以及 Tangier disease 和家族性 HDL 缺乏症之間的臨床光譜。

subject: Flavonoids

context.en-US: Flavonoids scavenge reactive oxygen species including superoxide, hydrogen peroxide, hydroxyl radicals, and peroxynitrite through their phenolic hydroxyl groups. Their redox-active structures allow them to donate electrons and terminate radical chains. The directionality is antioxidant to radical neutralization. A caveat is that flavonoids are often poorly bioavailable and extensively metabolized, so cellular concentrations may be far below those used in vitro. Their metal-chelating capacity further suppresses the metal-catalyzed generation of hydroxyl radicals from hydrogen peroxide.
context.zh-TW: Flavonoids 透過酚羥基清除 reactive oxygen species，包括超氧化物、hydrogen peroxide、hydroxyl radicals 和 peroxynitrite。它們的氧化還原活性結構使它們能夠提供電子並終止自由基鏈。方向性是抗氧化至自由基中和。需要注意的是，flavonoids 的生物利用度通常較低且代謝廣泛，因此細胞濃度可能遠低於體外使用的濃度。它們的金屬螯合能力進一步抑制了 hydrogen peroxide 的金屬催化生成 hydroxyl radicals。

subject: Flavonoids

context.en-US: Flavonoids activate NRF2 by modifying KEAP1 cysteine residues, releasing NRF2 to induce phase-II and antioxidant enzymes. This engages the endogenous defense program rather than only direct scavenging. The directionality is thiol modification to transcriptional antioxidant response. A caveat is that the extent of NRF2 activation is structure-specific among flavonoids and may be modest at physiological exposure levels. This pathway is thought to mediate much of the long-term protection ascribed to flavonoid-rich diets, distinct from transient direct scavenging.
context.zh-TW: Flavonoids 透過修飾 KEAP1 半胱氨酸殘基活化 NRF2，釋放 NRF2 誘導 II 相酵素和抗氧化酶。這涉及內源性防禦程序，而不僅僅是直接清除。方向性是轉錄antioxidant response的硫醇修飾。需要注意的是，NRF2 的活化程度在 flavonoids 中具有結構特異性，並且在生理暴露水平下可能是適度的。這條途徑被認為介導了富含類黃酮飲食的大部分長期保護作用，與短暫的直接清除不同。

subject: Flavonoids

context.en-US: Flavonoids suppress NF-kappaB by inhibiting its activation and nuclear translocation, thereby dampening expression of inflammatory cytokines and adhesion molecules. This anti-inflammatory action complements their antioxidant effects. The directionality is flavonoid to suppressed inflammatory transcription. A caveat is that some flavonoids can also act as pro-oxidants or modulate other pathways, so the net immune effect is concentration- and context-dependent. Reduced NF-kappaB activity in turn lowers adhesion-molecule expression and leukocyte recruitment at sites of inflammation.
context.zh-TW: Flavonoids 透過抑制 NF-κB 的活化和核轉位來抑制 NF-κB，從而抑制發炎細胞因子和黏附分子的表達。這種抗發炎作用補充了它們的抗氧化作用。方向性是類黃酮抑制發炎轉錄。需要注意的是，一些 flavonoids 也可以充當 pro-oxidants 或調節其他途徑，因此淨免疫效應是濃度和環境依賴性的。 NF-κB 活性降低反過來又會降低發炎部位的黏附分子表現和白血球募集。

context.en-US: Flavonoids inhibit NADPH oxidase by blocking p47phox translocation to the membrane, reducing superoxide production in endothelial and phagocytic cells. This interrupts a major enzymatic ROS source. The directionality is flavonoid to NOX assembly inhibition. A caveat is that different flavonoids preferentially target different NOX isoforms, and effects vary with structure and bioavailability. This inhibition is shared by many dietary flavonoids and contributes to their vasculo- and cardioprotective effects, addressing the source rather than only the products of oxidant generation.
context.zh-TW: Flavonoids 透過阻斷 p47phox 易位至膜來抑制 NADPH oxidase，從而減少內皮細胞和吞噬細胞中超氧化物的產生。這會中斷 ROS 的主要酵素源。方向性是類黃酮對 NOX 組裝的抑制。需要注意的是，不同的 flavonoids 優先針對不同的 NOX 同工型，且效果因結構和生物利用度而異。許多飲食中的 flavonoids 都具有這種抑製作用，有助於其血管和心臟保護作用，解決氧化劑生成的根源而不僅僅是產物。

subject: Flavonoids

context.en-US: Flavonoids can act as pro-oxidants at high concentrations because, in the presence of transition metals, they undergo autoxidation that generates semiquinone radicals and subsequently superoxide and H2O2. This biphasic behavior underlies their hormetic profile. The directionality is high-dose flavonoid to radical generation. A caveat is that pro-oxidant effects are favored by metal abundance and high dose, whereas low doses are generally antioxidant. This pro-oxidant behavior is implicated in their anticancer effects, where selective ROS generation can drive apoptosis in malignant cells.
context.zh-TW: Flavonoids 在高濃度下可以充當 pro-oxidants，因為在過渡金屬存在的情況下，它們會發生 autoxidation，生成半醌自由基，隨後生成超氧化物和 H2O2。这种双相行为是其毒物兴奋效应的基础。方向性是大剂量黄酮类物质向自由基生成。需要注意的是，金属丰度和高剂量有利于促氧化作用，而低剂量通常具有抗氧化作用。这种促氧化行为与它们的抗 cancer 作用有关，其中选择性 ROS 生成可以在恶性细胞中驱动 apoptosis。

context.en-US: Genistein is a type of flavonoids, specifically an isoflavone found abundantly in soy, and it shares the redox and signaling properties of the broader flavonoid class. Its structure includes a phenolic A ring that confers antioxidant activity. The directionality is subclass membership within the flavonoid family. A caveat is that genistein also has estrogen-receptor modulatory activity distinct from its antioxidant effects. Genistein's antioxidant actions are complemented by estrogen-receptor signaling, tyrosine-kinase inhibition, and effects on eNOS and NOX, making it a multitarget isoflavone.
context.zh-TW: Genistein 是 flavonoids 的一種類型，特別是大豆中大量存在的異黃酮，它具有更廣泛的黃酮類化合物的氧化還原和信號特性。其結構包括具有抗氧化活性的酚A環。方向性是類黃酮家族中的子類成員。需要注意的是，genistein 還具有與其抗氧化作用不同的雌激素受體調節活性。 Genistein 的抗氧化作用與雌激素受體訊號傳導、tyrosine 激酶抑制以及對 eNOS 和 NOX 的作用相輔相成，使其成為多靶點異黃酮。

context.en-US: Genistein activates NRF2 by covalently modifying KEAP1 cysteine residues, analogous to other electrophilic flavonoids, leading to induction of HO-1, NQO1, and glutathione-pathway enzymes. This reinforces cellular antioxidant capacity. The directionality is thiol modification to NRF2-dependent transcription. A caveat is that genistein's NRF2 activation competes with its other receptor activities, and in vivo magnitude depends on metabolism. Sustained NRF2-driven defenses are thought to contribute to genistein's protection against oxidative DNA damage and metabolic stress.
context.zh-TW: Genistein 透過共價修飾 KEAP1 半胱氨酸殘基活化 NRF2，類似於其他親電子 flavonoids，導致 HO-1、NQO1 和 glutathione 途徑酵素的誘導。這增強了細胞的抗氧化能力。方向性是對 NRF2 依賴性轉錄的硫醇修飾。需要注意的是，genistein 的 NRF2 活化與其其他受體活性競爭，體內強度取決於代謝。持續的 NRF2 驅動的防禦被認為有助於 genistein 抵抗氧化 DNA damage 和代謝壓力。

context.en-US: Genistein inhibits NADPH oxidase, reducing superoxide production in endothelial cells by interfering with NOX assembly and signaling. This contributes to its vasculoprotective profile. The directionality is isoflavone to lowered NOX-derived ROS. A caveat is that genistein's effects on NOX are cell-type specific and can be modulated by its estrogen-receptor activity. By limiting superoxide, genistein also spares nitric oxide from rapid inactivation, improving endothelial function and vascular tone. These effects, combined with suppression of adhesion-molecule expression, underpin its atheroprotective properties in experimental and epidemiological studies.
context.zh-TW: Genistein 抑制 NADPH oxidase，透過幹擾 NOX 組裝和訊號傳導來減少內皮細胞中超氧化物的產生。這有助於其血管保護作用。方向性是異黃酮至降低NOX衍生的ROS。需要注意的是，genistein 對 NOX 的影響是細胞類型特異性的，並且可以透過其雌激素受體活性進行調節。透過限制超氧化物，genistein 還可以防止 nitric oxide 快速失活，從而改善內皮功能和血管張力。這些作用與黏附分子表現的抑制相結合，在實驗和流行病學研究中鞏固了其動脈粥狀硬化保護特性。

context.en-US: Genistein enhances nitric oxide bioavailability by upregulating eNOS expression and scavenging superoxide that would otherwise consume NO. The combined effect improves endothelial NO signaling. The directionality is isoflavone to increased bioavailable NO. A caveat is that genistein can also bind estrogen receptors, so part of its vascular benefit may be receptor-mediated rather than purely redox-based. Clinical studies report improved flow-mediated dilation after soy isoflavone intake, consistent with enhanced NO-dependent vasorelaxation in vivo.
context.zh-TW: Genistein 透過上調 eNOS 表現並清除超氧化物來增強 nitric oxide bioavailability，否則超氧化物會消耗 NO。綜合作用可改善內皮 NO 訊號傳導。異黃酮的方向性是增加生物可利用的一氧化氮。需要注意的是，genistein 還可以結合雌激素受體，因此其部分血管益處可能是受體介導的，而不是純粹基於氧化還原的。臨床研究報告稱，攝取大豆異黃酮後血流介導的擴張得到改善，這與體內 NO 依賴性血管舒張作用的增強一致。

context.en-US: Hypochlorous acid is generated by myeloperoxidase, which uses H2O2 and chloride to produce HOCl in activated neutrophils and monocytes. This reaction concentrates a potent oxidant at infection and inflammatory sites. The directionality is MPO catalysis to HOCl formation. A caveat is that MPO can also use bromide and other halides, so related hypohalous acids are produced alongside HOCl. Because HOCl is produced only in proximity to MPO, the appearance of its chlorinated products such as 3-chlorotyrosine is a highly specific footprint of MPO activity in vivo.
context.zh-TW: Hypochlorous acid 由 myeloperoxidase 生成，myeloperoxidase 使用 H2O2 和氯化物在活化的嗜中性球和單核球產生 HOCl。此反應在感染和發炎部位濃縮了強效氧化劑。方向性是 MPO 催化 HOCl 的形成。要注意的是，MPO 還可以使用溴化物和其他鹵化物，因此相關的次鹵酸會與 HOCl 一起產生。由於 HOCl 僅在 MPO 附近產生，因此其氯化產物（例如 3-chlorotyrosine）的出現是 MPO 體內活性的高度特異性足跡。

context.en-US: Hypochlorous acid is the primary microbicidal oxidant of the innate immune system, killing pathogens through widespread oxidation of thiols, amines, and proteins in microbes. Its potency makes it central to neutrophil host defense. The directionality is HOCl to microbial killing. A caveat is that HOCl is non-selective and, when extrapolated beyond the phagolysosome, damages host tissues and proteins, contributing to inflammatory injury. Defects in MPO impair HOCl production and, although compensated in most patients, illustrate the enzyme's central role in oxidant-mediated killing.
context.zh-TW: Hypochlorous acid 是 innate immune system 的主要殺菌氧化劑，透過微生物中硫醇、胺和 proteins 的廣泛氧化來殺死病原體。它的效力使其成為中性粒細胞宿主防禦的核心。方向性是次氯酸對微生物的殺滅作用。需要注意的是，HOCl 是非選擇性的，當外推到吞噬溶小體之外時，會損害宿主組織和 proteins，導致發炎損傷。 MPO 的缺陷會損害 HOCl 的產生，儘管在大多數患者中得到補償，但說明了該酶在氧化劑介導的殺傷中的核心作用。

context.en-US: Hypochlorous acid inactivates alpha-1 antitrypsin by oxidizing critical residues, especially methionine, abolishing its ability to inhibit neutrophil elastase. In COPD and similar conditions this unleashes unopposed proteolysis that destroys lung matrix. The directionality is HOCl to serpin inactivation to tissue damage. A caveat is that cigarette smoke and other oxidants also inactivate alpha-1 antitrypsin, so HOCl is one of several mechanisms. The same oxidative inactivation contributes to emphysema in cigarette smokers, where neutrophil-derived HOCl meets a poorly protected lung interstitium.
context.zh-TW: Hypochlorous acid 透過氧化關鍵殘基（尤其是蛋胺酸）使 alpha-1 antitrypsin 失去活性，從而消除其抑制嗜中性球彈性蛋白酶的能力。在慢性阻塞性肺病和類似的情況下，這會釋放出不受對抗的蛋白質分解作用，從而破壞肺基質。方向性是 HOCl 至絲胺酸蛋白酶抑制劑失活至組織損傷。需要注意的是，cigarette smoke 和其他氧化劑也會使 alpha-1 antitrypsin 失活，因此 HOCl 是多種機制之一。同樣的氧化失活會導致 cigarette smokers 中的肺氣腫，其中中性粒細胞衍生的次氯酸與保護不良的肺間質相遇。

context.en-US: Hypochlorous acid depletes glutathione because GSH is rapidly oxidized by HOCl to glutathione sulfonamide and disulfides, consuming the major cellular antioxidant. This leaves cells vulnerable to further oxidative insult. The directionality is HOCl to thiol consumption. A caveat is that other oxidants also drain GSH, and the disulfide products can be partially recycled by the thioredoxin and glutaredoxin systems. Because GSH is a major target, HOCl exposure rapidly overwhelms the thiol redox buffer and sensitizes cells to secondary oxidative injury.
context.zh-TW: Hypochlorous acid 會消耗 glutathione，因為 GSH 被 HOCl 快速氧化為 glutathione 磺酰胺和二硫化物，消耗主要的細胞抗氧化劑。這使得細胞容易受到進一步的氧化損傷。方向性是 HOCl 到硫醇的消耗。需要注意的是，其他氧化劑也會消耗穀胱甘肽，而二硫化物產物可以被硫氧還蛋白和穀氧還蛋白系統部分回收。由於 GSH 是主要目標，HOCl 暴露會迅速淹沒硫醇氧化還原緩衝液，並使細胞對繼發性氧化損傷敏感。

context.en-US: Hypochlorous acid chlorinates tyrosine to form 3-chlorotyrosine, a stable adduct that is a specific biomarker of myeloperoxidase activity in vivo. Its presence marks HOCl exposure in inflamed tissues. The directionality is HOCl to chlorinated protein residue. A caveat is that 3-chlorotyrosine reflects historical MPO activity and can be turned over with protein degradation, so it is an integrative rather than instantaneous marker. 3-chlorotyrosine levels rise in atherosclerotic plaques, pneumonia, and other inflammatory conditions, supporting its use as a clinical research biomarker.
context.zh-TW: Hypochlorous acid 氯化 tyrosine 形成 3-chlorotyrosine，這是一種穩定的加合物，是體內 myeloperoxidase 活性的特定生物標記。它的存在標誌著發炎組織中的次氯酸暴露。方向性是 HOCl 到氯化蛋白質殘基。需要注意的是，3-chlorotyrosine 反映了歷史 MPO 活性，並且可以隨著蛋白質降解而翻轉，因此它是一個綜合標記，而不是瞬時標記。 3-chlorotyrosine 水平在 atheros 硬化斑塊、肺炎和其他發炎性疾病中升高，支持其用作臨床研究生物標記。

context.en-US: L-arginine is a precursor for nitric oxide, as the guanidino nitrogen of arginine is converted to NO and L-citrulline by nitric oxide synthase. This makes arginine availability a determinant of NO production. The directionality is substrate to product in NOS catalysis. A caveat is that arginine availability rarely limits basal eNOS because intracellular arginine is usually sufficient, though competition with arginase can matter. The arginine paradox, in which supplemental arginine raises NO despite saturating intracellular concentrations, points to compartmentalized arginine pools and competition with arginase.
context.zh-TW: L-arginine 是 nitric oxide 的前體，因為精胺酸的胍基氮被 nitric oxide synthase 轉化為 NO 和 L-瓜胺酸。這使得精胺酸的可用性成為一氧化氮產生的決定因素。 NOS 催化中的方向性是從底物到產物。需要注意的是，精胺酸的可用性很少限制基礎 eNOS，因為細胞內精胺酸通常就足夠了，儘管與 arginase 的競爭可能很重要。精氨酸悖論是，儘管細胞內濃度已飽和，但補充精氨酸仍會升高 NO，這表明精氨酸庫區分開來，並與 arginase 競爭。

context.en-US: L-arginine is converted by nitric oxide synthase in a two-step monooxygenase reaction requiring NADPH, FAD, FMN, tetrahydrobiopterin, and heme. The enzyme first forms N-hydroxyarginine and then releases NO and citrulline. The directionality is enzyme-catalyzed oxidation of arginine to NO. A caveat is that uncoupled NOS, lacking BH4 or arginine, diverts the reaction to superoxide instead of NO. When BH4 or L-arginine is limiting, NOS becomes uncoupled and produces superoxide instead of NO, so substrate availability also shapes the enzyme's redox output.
context.zh-TW: L-arginine 在需要 NADPH、FAD、FMN、tetrahydrobiopterin 和血紅素的兩步驟單加氧酶反應中由 nitric oxide synthase 轉化。此酵素首先形成 N-羥基精氨酸，然後釋放 NO 和瓜氨酸。方向性是酵素催化精胺酸氧化成NO。需要注意的是，未偶聯的 NOS，缺乏 BH4 或精氨酸，會將反應轉向超氧化物而不是 NO。當 BH4 或 L-arginine 受到限制時，NOS 會解偶聯並產生超氧化物而不是 NO，因此底物可用性也會影響酵素的氧化還原輸出。

context.en-US: Arginase competes with NOS for L-arginine, hydrolyzing arginine to ornithine and urea and thereby lowering substrate available for NO synthesis. In vascular and immune contexts this shifts the arginine pool away from NO toward polyamine and proline synthesis. The directionality is metabolic competition to reduced NO. A caveat is that arginase and NOS also compete for the same intracellular compartment, so local colocalization strongly influences the outcome. Arginase is induced by inflammatory cytokines and oxidants, so vascular arginase upregulation is a recognized mechanism of endothelial dysfunction.
context.zh-TW: Arginase 與 NOS 競爭 L-arginine，將精氨酸水解為鳥氨酸和尿素，從而降低可用於 NO 合成的底物。在血管和免疫環境中，這會將精胺酸池從一氧化氮轉向多胺和脯胺酸合成。方向性是代謝競爭以減少NO。需要注意的是，arginase 和 NOS 也會競爭相同的細胞內區室，因此局部共定位會強烈影響結果。 Arginase 是由發炎細胞因子和氧化劑誘導的，因此血管 arginase 上調是 endothelial dysfunction 的公認機制。

context.en-US: The L-arginine to ADMA ratio is a biomarker of cardiovascular risk because it reflects the balance between NOS substrate and the endogenous inhibitor ADMA. A low ratio predicts impaired NO bioavailability and endothelial dysfunction. The directionality is substrate-inhibitor balance to vascular risk. A caveat is that the ratio is one of several endothelial markers and is influenced by renal function and inflammation, which regulate ADMA clearance. The ratio has been proposed as a clinically accessible biomarker for monitoring NO-related vascular health in at-risk populations.
context.zh-TW: L-arginine 與 ADMA 的比率是 cardiovascular risk 的生物標記物，因為它反映了 NOS 底物和內源性抑制劑 ADMA 之間的平衡。低比率預示著 NO 生物利用度和 endothelial dysfunction 受損。方向性是血管風險的底物-抑制劑平衡。需要注意的是，該比率是幾種內皮標記物之一，並受到腎功能和發炎的影響，從而調節 ADMA 清除率。該比率已被提議作為臨床上可用的生物標記物，用於監測高風險族群中與一氧化氮相關的血管健康。

context.en-US: Nitric oxide synthase catalyzes nitric oxide production from L-arginine in a calcium- or calmodulin-regulated reaction that also yields citrulline. The three NOS isoforms (eNOS, nNOS, iNOS) share this chemistry but differ in regulation and output. The directionality is enzyme catalysis to NO formation. A caveat is that NOS can become uncoupled and produce superoxide instead when BH4 or arginine is limiting, inverting its normal function. eNOS-derived NO regulates vascular tone, while nNOS supports neurotransmission and iNOS mediates high-output immune killing.
context.zh-TW: Nitric oxide synthase 在鈣或鈣調蛋白調節反應中催化 L-arginine 生成 nitric oxide，此反應也產生瓜胺酸。三種 NOS 亞型（eNOS、nNOS、iNOS）具有相同的化學性質，但在調節和輸出方面有所不同。方向性是酵素催化NO形成。需要注意的是，當 BH4 或精胺酸受到限制時，NOS 可能會解偶聯並產生超氧化物，從而反轉其正常功能。 eNOS 衍生的 NO 調節血管張力，而 nNOS 支持神經傳遞，iNOS 介導高輸出免疫殺傷。

context.en-US: eNOS produces NO for vasodilation, platelet inhibition, and maintenance of the vascular barrier, making it the principal source of basal endothelium-derived relaxing factor. Its activity is shear-stress regulated and couples blood flow to vessel relaxation. The directionality is endothelial NO to vascular homeostasis. A caveat is that eNOS also promotes angiogenesis and, when uncoupled, becomes a ROS source, so its role is context-dependent. Impairment of eNOS-NO signaling, whether by substrate deficiency, BH4 loss, or NO scavenging by superoxide, underlies most forms of endothelial dysfunction.
context.zh-TW: eNOS 產生 NO 用於 vasodilation、血小板抑制和血管屏障的維持，使其成為基底內皮源性舒張因子的主要來源。其活性受剪切應力調節，並將血流與血管鬆弛耦合。方向性是內皮NO對血管穩態的影響。需要注意的是，eNOS 也促進血管生成，並且在解耦時成為 ROS 源，因此其作用取決於上下文。 eNOS-NO 訊號傳導受損，無論是由於底物缺乏、BH4 缺失或超氧化物清除 NO，都是大多數形式的 endothelial dysfunction 的基礎。

context.en-US: iNOS produces high-output NO for innate immune defense, generating micromolar NO in activated macrophages and other innate cells to kill intracellular pathogens. This sustained output is transcriptionally induced by cytokines and microbial products. The directionality is immune activation to bactericidal NO burst. A caveat is that the same high NO combines with superoxide to form peroxynitrite, causing collateral nitrative tissue damage. Because its expression is transcriptionally controlled, iNOS is absent from resting cells but appears within hours of cytokine or pathogen exposure.
context.zh-TW: iNOS為innate immune defense產生高輸出NO，在活化的巨噬細胞和其他先天細胞中產生微摩爾NO以殺死細胞內病原體。這種持續的輸出是由細胞激素和微生物產物轉錄誘導的。方向性是對殺菌性NO爆發的免疫活化。需要注意的是，同樣高的 NO 與超氧化物結合形成 peroxynitrite，導致附帶的硝化組織損傷。因為其表現受轉錄控制，所以 iNOS 在靜止細胞中不存在，但在細胞激素或病原體暴露後數小時內出現。

context.en-US: eNOS uncoupling produces superoxide radicals when tetrahydrobiopterin or L-arginine becomes limiting, redirecting electron flow from NO synthesis to oxygen reduction. The enzyme thereby switches from vasoprotection to oxidative injury. The directionality is cofactor deficiency to superoxide generation. A caveat is that partial uncoupling still yields some NO, and the transition is graded rather than an on/off switch. This switch contributes to vascular disease progression and explains why restoring BH4 or arginine improves endothelial function in experimental models.
context.zh-TW: 當 tetrahydrobiopterin 或 L-arginine 受到限制時，eNOS 解偶聯產生 superoxide radicals，將電子流從 NO 合成重新導向到氧還原。該酶從而從血管保護轉變為氧化損傷。方向性是超氧化物生成的輔因子缺乏。需要注意的是，部分解耦仍然會產生一些 NO，並且過渡是分級的，而不是開/關開關。這種轉變有助於血管疾病的進展，並解釋了為什麼在實驗模型中恢復 BH4 或精氨酸可以改善內皮功能。

context.en-US: iNOS drives nitrative stress because its high NO output reacts with concomitant superoxide to form peroxynitrite, especially in inflamed tissues. This makes iNOS a key enzymatic source of nitrating oxidants. The directionality is inducible NO to peroxynitrite-mediated nitration. A caveat is that peroxynitrite also arises from eNOS uncoupling and other sources, so iNOS is a major but not sole driver of nitrative stress. Co-induction of iNOS and NOX in the same cells maximizes peroxynitrite flux, making inflamed tissue a major site of protein nitration.
context.zh-TW: iNOS 驅動 nitrative stress，因為其高 NO 輸出與伴隨的超氧化物反應形成 peroxynitrite，特別是在發炎組織中。這使得 iNOS 成為硝化氧化劑的關鍵酶源。方向性是 peroxynitrite 介導的硝化作用的誘導型 NO。需要注意的是，peroxynitrite 也源自於 eNOS 解耦和其他來源，因此 iNOS 是 nitrative stress 的主要驅動因素，但不是唯一的驅動因素。同一細胞中 iNOS 和 NOX 的共誘導使 peroxynitrite 通量最大化，使發炎組織成為蛋白質硝化的主要部位。

context.en-US: Polyphenols activate NRF2 by modifying KEAP1 cysteine residues, releasing NRF2 to induce more than 200 cytoprotective and antioxidant genes. This harnesses the cell's own defense program rather than only direct scavenging. The directionality is electrophilic polyphenol to NRF2-dependent transcription. A caveat is that the specific cysteines and magnitude of activation differ among polyphenol structures and depend on metabolism. Examples include resveratrol, curcumin, and EGCG, whose electrophilic moieties and metabolites trigger NRF2 stabilization.
context.zh-TW: Polyphenols 透過修飾 KEAP1 半胱氨酸殘基活化 NRF2，釋放 NRF2 誘導 200 多個細胞保護和抗氧化基因。這利用了細胞自身的防禦程序，而不僅僅是直接清除。方向性是親電子多酚到NRF2依賴的轉錄。需要注意的是，多酚結構之間的特定半胱氨酸和活化程度不同，並且取決於代謝。例子包括白藜蘆醇、薑黃素和 EGCG，其親電子部分和代謝物可觸發 NRF2 穩定。

context.en-US: Polyphenols inhibit NADPH oxidase by blocking p47phox translocation to the membrane, lowering superoxide production in endothelial and inflammatory cells. This reduces a major enzymatic ROS source and complements their NRF2 activation. The directionality is polyphenol to NOX assembly inhibition. A caveat is that effects are isoform- and cell-type specific, and in vivo concentrations after metabolism may be low. This is one route by which dietary polyphenols lower vascular oxidative burden beyond their direct radical-scavenging capacity.
context.zh-TW: Polyphenols 透過阻斷 p47phox 易位至膜來抑制 NADPH oxidase，從而降低內皮細胞和發炎細胞中超氧化物的產生。這減少了主要的酶 ROS 來源並補充了它們的 NRF2 活化。方向性是多酚對 NOX 組裝的抑制。需要注意的是，影響是異構體和細胞類型特異性的，代謝後的體內濃度可能較低。這是飲食 polyphenols 降低血管氧化負擔超出其直接自由基清除能力的途徑之一。

context.en-US: Polyphenols are metabolized by the gut microbiome, with the majority of dietary polyphenols reaching the colon intact for bacterial transformation into absorbable metabolites. Microbial catabolism both activates and inactivates these compounds, shaping their systemic bioavailability. The directionality is host diet to microbial biotransformation. A caveat is that the resulting metabolites, not the parent compounds, often mediate the in vivo antioxidant and signaling effects. Inter-individual differences in microbial polyphenol metabolism explain much of the variability in the health effects of these compounds.
context.zh-TW: Polyphenols 由 gut microbiome 代謝，大部分飲食 polyphenols 完整地到達結腸，被細菌轉化為可吸收的代謝物。微生物分解代謝既可以活化也可以使這些化合物失活，從而影響它們的全身生物利用度。方向性是宿主飲食對微生物生物轉化的影響。需要注意的是，產生的代謝物，而不是母體化合物，通常介導體體內抗氧化和訊號傳導作用。微生物多酚代謝的個體間差異解釋了這些化合物對健康影響的大部分差異。

context.en-US: Polyphenols exhibit hormesis, showing beneficial low-dose antioxidant and signaling effects but pro-oxidant or toxic high-dose effects. This biphasic response is typical of many redox-active phytochemicals. The directionality is dose-dependent switch from protection to harm. A caveat is that the hormetic window varies widely by compound, tissue, and individual microbiome, so blanket dosing claims are unreliable. This hormetic principle underlies the common advice that polyphenols are best consumed as part of whole foods rather than as high-dose supplements.
context.zh-TW: Polyphenols 表現出 hormesis，顯示出有益的低劑量抗氧化和訊號傳導作用，但顯示出促氧化或有毒的高劑量作用。這種雙相反應是許多氧化還原活性植物化學物質的典型特徵。方向性是從保護到傷害的劑量依賴性轉換。需要注意的是，毒物興奮效應窗口因化合物、組織和個體微生物組的不同而有很大差異，因此總體劑量聲明並不可靠。這種興奮效應原理是常見建議的基礎，即 polyphenols 最好是作為天然食品的一部分而不是作為高劑量補充劑。

context.en-US: Polyphenols reduce risk of cardiovascular disease through improved endothelial function, inhibition of LDL oxidation, and modest blood-pressure and anti-inflammatory effects. Epidemiological and intervention data support a protective association. The directionality is polyphenol intake to lower vascular risk. A caveat is that much evidence is observational or from supraphysiological doses, and the confidence in a direct causal preventive effect is moderate rather than definitive. Cocoa flavanols and olive-oil polyphenols are among the most studied, with evidence for improved endothelial function and blood pressure.
context.zh-TW: Polyphenols 透過改善內皮功能、抑制 LDL 氧化以及適度的血壓和抗發炎作用來降低 cardiovascular disease 的風險。流行病學和乾預數據支持保護性關聯。方向性是攝取多酚以降低血管風險。需要注意的是，許多證據是觀察性的或來自超生理劑量的，並且對直接因果預防作用的信心是中等的而不是確定的。可可黃烷醇和橄欖油 polyphenols 是研究最多的化合物之一，有證據表明它們可以改善內皮功能和血壓。

context.en-US: Nucleic acids are prone to damage by reactive oxygen species, particularly hydroxyl radicals, which attack both the sugar-phosphate backbone and nucleobases. Guanine is the most readily oxidized base, yielding 8-oxo-dG and strand lesions. The directionality is ROS to nucleic-acid modification. A caveat is that DNA is partly protected by histones, repair enzymes, and metal sequestration, so damage is non-uniform across the genome. Oxidative lesions accumulate with age and in numerous diseases, and their levels are widely used as biomarkers of oxidative exposure and damage.
context.zh-TW: Nucleic acids 很容易被 reactive oxygen species，特別是 hydroxyl radicals 損壞，hydroxyl radicals 會攻擊糖磷酸主鏈和核鹼基。鳥嘌呤是最容易被氧化的鹼基，產生 8-oxo-dG 和鏈損傷。方向性是ROS到核酸修飾。需要注意的是，DNA 部分受到組蛋白、修復酵素和金屬隔離的保護，因此基因組中的損傷是不均勻的。氧化損傷隨著年齡的增長和在許多疾病中積累，其水平被廣泛用作氧化暴露和損傷的生物標記。

context.en-US: 8-oxo-2'-deoxyguanosine is the most abundant oxidative lesion in DNA, with roughly 10^3 to 10^6 lesions per cell per day arising from normal metabolism and extrinsic insults. Its prevalence reflects both high formation rate and efficient but imperfect repair. The directionality is oxidation of guanine to the dominant adduct. A caveat is that the steady-state level integrates formation and repair, so it is an indirect rather than instantaneous measure of ROS flux. The steady-state 8-oxodG level is influenced by both the rate of oxidation and the efficiency of OGG1-mediated repair, so it reflects the balance between insult and defense.
context.zh-TW: 8-oxo-2'-deoxyguanosine 是 DNA 中最豐富的氧化損傷，每個細胞每天約有 10^3 至 10^6 個損傷，這些損傷是由正常代謝和外在損傷引起的。它的流行反映了高形成率和有效但不完善的修復。方向性是鳥嘌呤氧化成主要加合物。需要注意的是，穩態水平整合了形成和修復，因此它是 ROS 通量的間接而非瞬時測量。穩態8-oxodG水平受到氧化速率和OGG1介導的修復效率的影響，因此它反映了損傷和防禦之間的平衡。

context.en-US: Mitochondrial DNA is particularly susceptible to oxidative DNA damage because it lies near the electron-transport chain, lacks protective histones, and has limited repair capacity relative to nuclear DNA. This makes mtDNA a sensitive early marker of mitochondrial oxidant stress. The directionality is proximity to ROS source to increased lesion frequency. A caveat is that mtDNA damage can also arise from replication errors and base-excision-repair intermediates, so ROS is a major but not exclusive cause.
context.zh-TW: Mitochondrial DNA 特別容易受到氧化 DNA damage 的影響，因為它位於電子傳遞鏈附近，缺乏保護性組蛋白，且相對於核 DNA 的修復能力有限。這使得 mtDNA 成為 mitochondria1 氧化壓力的敏感早期標記。方向性是接近ROS源以增加病變頻率。需要注意的是，mtDNA damage 也可能由複製錯誤和鹼基切除修復中間體引起，因此 ROS 是一個主要但不是唯一的原因。

context.en-US: Base excision repair is the primary repair pathway for oxidative DNA damage, initiated by lesion-specific DNA glycosylases such as OGG1 that excise oxidized bases and hand the intermediate to downstream nucleases, polymerases, and ligases. This pathway restores genome integrity after ROS exposure. The directionality is lesion recognition to excision and resynthesis. A caveat is that BER can be overwhelmed or error-prone under heavy damage, and backup pathways (MMR, NER) handle subsets of lesions.
context.zh-TW: Base excision repair 是氧化 DNA damage 的主要修復途徑，由病變特異性 DNA 糖基酶（例如 OGG1）啟動，該酶切除氧化鹼基並將中間體傳遞給下游核酸酶、聚合酶和連接酶。此途徑在 ROS 暴露後恢復基因組完整性。方向性是病灶識別到切除和再合成。需要注意的是，在嚴重損壞的情況下，BER 可能會被淹沒或容易出錯，而備用路徑（MMR、NER）會處理損傷的子集。

context.en-US: Proteins are major targets of oxidative stress, sustaining side-chain oxidation, backbone fragmentation, and cross-linking that alter enzyme activity, signaling, and turnover. Because proteins are abundant and long-lived, they integrate oxidative exposure over time. The directionality is oxidant to protein modification. A caveat is that some oxidative modifications are reversible (e.g., methionine sulfoxide) and can serve signaling roles rather than purely damage. Protein oxidation markers such as carbonylation and 3-nitrotyrosine are therefore widely used to estimate the severity of oxidative burden in disease.
context.zh-TW: Proteins 是 oxidative stress 的主要靶標，維持側鏈氧化、主鏈斷裂和 cross 連接，從而改變酶活性、訊號傳導和周轉。由於 proteins 含量豐富且壽命長，因此它們會隨著時間的推移而整合氧化暴露。方向性是蛋白質修飾的氧化劑。需要注意的是，一些氧化修飾是可逆的（例如甲硫氨酸亞砜），並且可以發揮信號作用而不是純粹的損傷。因此，蛋白質氧化標記物（例如羰基化和 3-nitrotyrosine）被廣泛用於估計疾病中氧化負擔的嚴重程度。

context.en-US: Protein carbonylation is an irreversible modification of proteins introduced by metal-catalyzed oxidation or by adduction of lipid-peroxidation products to susceptible residues. It marks severe, often non-repairable oxidative damage and is used as a biomarker. The directionality is oxidative insult to stable carbonyl formation. A caveat is that carbonylation can also arise from glycation and other non-ROS processes, so it is not exclusively an oxidative-stress marker. Carbonyls can be measured in plasma, tissues, and cell lysates, and their accumulation is a hallmark of aging and age-related disease.
context.zh-TW: Protein carbonylation 是 proteins 的不可逆修飾，透過金屬催化氧化或透過脂質過氧化產物與敏感殘基的加合引入。它標誌著嚴重的、通常不可修復的氧化損傷，並被用作生物標記。方向性是對穩定羰基形成的氧化損傷。需要注意的是，羰基化也可能由糖化和其他非 ROS 過程引起，因此它不僅僅是氧化壓力標記。可以在血漿、組織和細胞裂解物中測量羰基，它們的累積是 aging 和年齡相關疾病的標誌。

context.en-US: Carbonylated proteins are degraded by the 20S proteasome, which recognizes their unfolded, oxidized structure and degrades them independently of ubiquitin. This removes damaged proteins before they aggregate or lose function. The directionality is oxidized protein to proteasomal clearance. A caveat is that severe oxidation can form cross-links that resist degradation and instead promote aggregates, especially in aging and neurodegeneration. Because 20S degradation is ATP- and ubiquitin-independent, it provides a rapid, energy-sparing route for clearing mildly oxidized proteins.
context.zh-TW: Carbonylated proteins 被 20S proteasome 降解，20S proteasome 識別其未折疊的氧化結構並獨立於泛素進行降解。這可以在損壞的 proteins 聚集或失去功能之前將其刪除。方向性是氧化蛋白到蛋白酶體清除。需要注意的是，嚴重氧化會形成 cross 連接，從而抵抗降解並促進聚集，特別是在 aging 和 neurodegeneration 中。由於 20S 降解不依賴 ATP 和泛素，因此它提供了一個快速、節能的途徑來清除輕度氧化的 proteins。

context.en-US: Methionine sulfoxide reductases repair oxidized methionine by reducing methionine sulfoxide back to methionine using the thioredoxin system. This restores protein function and acts as an antioxidant defense because methionine oxidation can be a benign, reversible sink for oxidants. The directionality is MsrA/MsrB-catalyzed reduction to repaired protein. A caveat is that repeated oxidation and repair of the same residue has a kinetic cost and is not unlimited, so chronic stress still accrues damage.
context.zh-TW: Methionine sulfoxide reductases 透過使用硫氧還蛋白系統將甲硫胺酸亞砜還原回甲硫胺酸來修復 oxidized methionine。這可以恢復蛋白質功能並起到抗氧化防禦作用，因為蛋氨酸氧化可以成為氧化劑的良性、可逆的吸收池。方向性是 MsrA/MsrB 催化還原為修復蛋白。需要注意的是，相同殘留物的重複氧化和修復會產生動力成本，而且不是無限的，因此慢性壓力仍然會造成損害。

context.en-US: Chronic obstructive pulmonary disease is characterized by persistent airway inflammation and poorly reversible airflow limitation driven by neutrophilic and macrophage inflammation. Oxidant-antioxidant imbalance in the lungs fuels this chronic inflammatory state. The directionality is inflammatory airway disease to oxidative burden. A caveat is that COPD heterogeneity means not all patients show the same oxidant signature, and smoking-independent forms exist. This inflammation is sustained by an oxidant-antioxidant imbalance that inactivates antiproteases and perpetuates tissue destruction.
context.zh-TW: Chronic obstructive pulmonary disease 的特徵是持續的 airway inflammation 和由中性粒細胞和巨噬細胞發炎驅動的可逆性差的氣流受限。肺部的氧化劑-抗氧化劑失衡加劇了這種慢性發炎狀態。方向性是發炎性氣道疾病對氧化負擔的影響。需要注意的是，COPD 異質性意味著並非所有患者都表現出相同的氧化劑特徵，並且存在 smoking 獨立形式。這種發炎是由氧化劑-抗氧化劑失衡所維持的，這種失衡會使抗蛋白酶失去活性並使組織破壞永久化。

context.en-US: Smoking is the leading cause of chronic obstructive pulmonary disease, with long-term tobacco smoke exposure triggering chronic airway inflammation and protease-antiprotease imbalance. The habit delivers both oxidants and pro-oxidant stimuli directly to the lung. The directionality is smoke exposure to COPD pathogenesis. A caveat is that only a subset of smokers develop clinically significant COPD, indicating genetic and occupational modifiers. Smoking cessation remains the most effective intervention, slowing the accelerated decline in lung function and reducing exacerbations.
context.zh-TW: Smoking 是 chronic obstructive pulmonary disease 的主要原因，長期暴露於菸草煙霧會引發慢性 airway inflammation 和蛋白酶-抗蛋白酶失衡。這個習慣將氧化劑和促氧化劑刺激直接輸送到肺部。方向性是菸霧暴露與COPD發病機轉的關係。需要注意的是，只有一小部分吸菸者會出現臨床上顯著的慢性阻塞性肺病，這表明遺傳和職業因素有影響。戒斷 Smoking 仍然是最有效的干預措施，可以減緩肺功能的加速下降並減少病情惡化。

context.en-US: Cigarette smoke contains free radicals, including semiquinone radicals, hydroxyl radicals, and nitric oxide, plus a large burden of gaseous and particulate oxidants. These directly and indirectly raise lung oxidant load. The directionality is smoke-derived radicals to tissue oxidation. A caveat is that the tar-phase semiquinones can redox-cycle and generate sustained ROS long after exposure, so the effect outlasts the inhaled puff. Both the gas phase and tar phase carry oxidants, and the balance between oxidant load and lung antioxidant capacity determines tissue damage.
context.zh-TW: Cigarette smoke 包含 free radicals，包括半醌自由基、hydroxyl radicals 和 nitric oxide，以及大量氣態和顆粒氧化劑。這些直接和間接地增加了肺的氧化負荷。方向性是煙霧衍生的自由基對組織的氧化。需要注意的是，焦油相半醌在暴露後很長一段時間內可以進行氧化還原循環並產生持續的 ROS，因此其效果比吸入的煙霧更持久。氣相和焦油相均攜帶氧化劑，氧化劑負荷與肺抗氧化能力之間的平衡決定了組織損傷。

context.en-US: NADPH oxidase is upregulated in chronic obstructive pulmonary disease, with NOX2 elevated roughly two- to three-fold in macrophages and neutrophils of patients. This enzymatic ROS source amplifies the oxidant burden already imposed by smoke. The directionality is disease state to increased NOX expression. A caveat is that multiple oxidant enzymes (XO, MPO, mitochondrial) contribute, so NOX upregulation is one facet of COPD oxidant biology. Targeting NOX enzymes is therefore considered a rational strategy to limit COPD oxidant burden beyond smoking cessation.
context.zh-TW: NADPH oxidase 在 chronic obstructive pulmonary disease 中上調，而 NOX2 在患者的巨噬細胞和嗜中性球中升高約兩到三倍。這種酵素 ROS 源放大了煙霧已經造成的氧化劑負擔。方向性是 NOX 表現增加的疾病狀態。需要注意的是，多種氧化酶（XO、MPO、mitochondria1）都有貢獻，因此 NOX 上調是 COPD 氧化生物學的一個面向。因此，針對 NOX 酶被認為是在 smoking 停止後限制 COPD 氧化劑負擔的合理策略。

context.en-US: Glutathione is depleted in chronic obstructive pulmonary disease, with epithelial lining fluid GSH reduced by 40 to 60 percent, weakening the first-line antioxidant defense of the airways. This depletion impairs detoxification of H2O2 and HOCl. The directionality is disease to lowered thiol buffer. A caveat is that systemic GSH may be maintained or even altered differently, and depletion is most marked in the epithelial fluid compartment. N-acetylcysteine and other GSH precursors have shown modest benefit in reducing exacerbations, supporting the relevance of thiol depletion.
context.zh-TW: chronic obstructive pulmonary disease 中的 Glutathione 被耗盡，上皮內層液 GSH 減少 40% 至 60%，削弱了氣道的一線抗氧化防禦。這種消耗會損害 H2O2 和 HOCl 的解毒作用。方向性是降低硫醇緩衝液的疾病。需要注意的是，全身穀胱甘肽可能會以不同的方式維持甚至改變，並且上皮液室中的消耗最為明顯。 N-乙醯半胱氨酸和其他穀胱甘肽前體在減少病情惡化方面顯示出一定的益處，支持硫醇消耗的相關性。

context.en-US: NRF2 is dysregulated in chronic obstructive pulmonary disease, with reduced nuclear NRF2 and blunted antioxidant-gene induction in macrophages despite ongoing oxidant stress. This failure of adaptation worsens the oxidant burden. The directionality is impaired NRF2 signaling to inadequate defense. A caveat is that NRF2 activation is often attempted therapeutically (e.g., with sulforaphane), so the relationship is a target as well as a defect. Restoring NRF2 function with activators such as sulforaphane is an active therapeutic strategy in COPD clinical research.
context.zh-TW: 儘管存在持續的氧化應激，但 chronic obstructive pulmonary disease 中的 NRF2 失調，核 NRF2 減少，巨噬細胞中抗氧化基因誘導減弱。這種適應失敗會加重氧化劑負擔。 NRF2 訊號的方向性受損，導致防禦不足。需要注意的是，NRF2 活化通常是在治療上嘗試的（例如，使用蘿蔔硫素），因此這種關係既是目標，也是缺陷。以蘿蔔硫素等活化劑恢復NRF2功能是COPD臨床研究中的一種積極的治療策略。

context.en-US: Amyloid-beta catalyzes hydrogen peroxide formation because Cu2+-bound Abeta reduces oxygen to H2O2 via Fenton-like chemistry at the metal-binding site. This makes Abeta plaques local ROS generators in the Alzheimer brain. The directionality is metal-bound peptide to H2O2 production. A caveat is that Abeta also promotes ROS through microglial activation and mitochondrial dysfunction, so catalyzed H2O2 is one of several sources. Because this chemistry requires redox-active metals, chelation of Cu2+ and Fe3+ is investigated as a way to limit Abeta-mediated oxidative damage.
context.zh-TW: 澱粉樣蛋白-β 催化 hydrogen peroxide 的形成，因為 Cu2+ 結合的 Abeta 透過金屬結合位點的類芬頓化學將氧還原為 H2O2。這使得阿貝塔在阿茲海默症大腦中形成了局部 ROS 生成器斑塊。方向性是金屬結合勝肽對 H2O2 所產生的影響。需要注意的是，Abeta 也透過小膠質細胞活化和 mitochondria1 功能障礙促進 ROS，因此催化 H 2 O 2 是幾個來源之一。由於這種化學反應需要 redox-active metals，因此研究了 Cu2+ 和 Fe3+ 的螯合作為限制 Abeta 介導的氧化損傷的一種方法。

context.en-US: Amyloid-beta impairs mitochondrial Complex IV (cytochrome c oxidase) after accumulating in mitochondria, depressing respiration and increasing electron leak. This links protein misfolding to bioenergetic failure and ROS. The directionality is Abeta mitochondrial localization to respiratory inhibition. A caveat is that Complex IV inhibition can be both a cause and consequence of oxidative damage in a feed-forward loop. The resulting energetic deficit may precede overt neurodegeneration and contributes to synaptic failure in Alzheimer's disease.
context.zh-TW: β 澱粉樣蛋白在 mitochondria 中累積後會損害 mitochondrial Complex IV（細胞色素 C 氧化酶），抑制呼吸並增加電子洩漏。這將蛋白質錯誤折疊與生物能量衰竭和 ROS 聯繫起來。方向性是Abeta mitochondria1定位於呼吸抑制。需要注意的是，複合物 IV 抑制既可能是前饋迴路中氧化損傷的原因，也可能是其結果。由此產生的能量缺乏可能先於明顯的 neurodegeneration 發生，並導致阿茲海默症的突觸衰竭。

context.en-US: Amyloid-beta induces lipid peroxidation through metal-catalyzed ROS and through direct interactions with membranes, generating MDA and 4-HNE. These aldehydes then further compromise synapses and proteins. The directionality is Abeta-driven oxidation to membrane damage. A caveat is that lipid peroxidation products also feed back to stabilize Abeta aggregation, creating a vicious cycle. These aldehydes modify membrane proteins and exacerbate synaptic damage, and lipid oxidation products are elevated in Alzheimer's disease brain and CSF.
context.zh-TW: β 澱粉樣蛋白透過金屬催化 ROS 並透過與膜的直接相互作用誘導 lipid peroxidation，生成 MDA 和 4-HNE。這些醛會進一步損害突觸和 proteins。方向性是 Abeta 驅動的氧化導致膜損傷。需要注意的是，lipid peroxidation 產品也會回饋穩定 Abeta 聚合，形成惡性循環。這些醛會修飾膜 proteins 並加劇突觸損傷，且脂質氧化產物在阿茲海默症大腦和腦脊髓液中升高。

context.en-US: Asthma is associated with glutathione depletion, as the GSH/GSSG ratio is markedly decreased in asthmatic airways, weakening local antioxidant defense. This sensitizes the airway to oxidant triggers and allergen-induced inflammation. The directionality is disease to lowered thiol buffer. A caveat is that glutathione changes vary by asthma phenotype and severity, and some patients show different redox patterns. Replenishing airway GSH with N-acetylcysteine has been explored as an adjunctive strategy to restore antioxidant capacity in asthmatic airways.
context.zh-TW: Asthma 與 glutathione depletion 相關，因為 asthmatic 氣道中的 GSH/GSSG 比率顯著降低，削弱了局部抗氧化防禦。這會使氣道對氧化劑觸發物和過敏原引起的發炎變得敏感。方向性是降低硫醇緩衝液的疾病。需要注意的是，glutathione 的變化因 asthma 表型和嚴重程度而異，並且一些患者表現出不同的氧化還原模式。人們已經探索以 N-乙醯半胱氨酸補充氣道 GSH 作為恢復 asthmatic 氣道抗氧化能力的輔助策略。

context.en-US: Oxidative stress correlates with asthma severity, with greater oxidant burden tracking with worse symptoms and higher exacerbation frequency. Biomarkers of lipid and protein oxidation rise during acute attacks. The directionality is oxidant load to clinical severity. A caveat is that correlation does not establish direction; severe asthma may also generate more ROS via eosinophil and NOX activity. These observations support the use of redox biomarkers in monitoring asthma control and evaluating antioxidant-based therapies.
context.zh-TW: Oxidative stress 與 asthma severity 相關，氧化負荷追蹤更大，症狀更嚴重，惡化頻率更高。在急性發作期間，脂質和蛋白質氧化的生物標記會升高。方向性是氧化負荷與臨床嚴重程度的關係。需要注意的是，相關性並不能確定方向；嚴重的asthma也可能透過嗜酸性粒細胞和NOX活性產生更多的ROS。這些觀察結果支持使用氧化還原生物標記物來監測 asthma 控制和評估基於抗氧化劑的療法。

context.en-US: Sulforaphane activates NRF2 by alkylating KEAP1 cysteines, displacing NRF2 and inducing antioxidant and phase-II genes; in asthma models it restores antioxidant gene expression in the airway. This makes it a prototype NRF2-activating phytochemical. The directionality is electrophile to NRF2-dependent defense. A caveat is that clinical benefit in asthma is promising but not yet definitive, and effects depend on dose and bioavailability. Because sulforaphane is derived from glucoraphanin in broccoli, dietary intake and supplementation are both being studied in respiratory and metabolic conditions.
context.zh-TW: 蘿蔔硫素，在西蘭花芽中大量發現，被強調為NRF2的強效激活劑和II期解毒酶的上調劑。NRF2是定義mitohormesis的急性ROS脈衝激活的關鍵應激反應通路之一，與AMPK、PGC-1α和SIRT1並列。因此，十字花科蔬菜在飲食方案中被推薦為富含多酚的xenohormetins和NRF2激活劑，支持hormetic反應。

context.en-US: Eosinophil peroxidase produces hypobromous acid (HOBr) by using bromide and H2O2 to generate the brominating oxidant in eosinophilic inflammation such as allergic asthma. HOBr is the eosinophil analog of neutrophil HOCl. The directionality is EPO catalysis to HOBr formation. A caveat is that HOBr is less studied than HOCl, and bromination biomarkers are less established, though it is similarly reactive toward proteins. Bromotyrosine adducts are elevated in allergic airway disease and serve as specific markers of eosinophil-mediated oxidant damage.
context.zh-TW: 在過敏性asthma等嗜酸性粒細胞發炎中，Eosinophil peroxidase透過使用溴化物和H2O2生成溴化氧化劑來產生hypobromous acid(HOBr)。 HOBr 是中性粒細胞 HOCl 的嗜酸性粒細胞類似物。方向性是 EPO 催化 HOBr 形成。需要注意的是，雖然 HOBr 對 proteins 具有類似的反應性，但與 HOCl 相比，對 HOBr 的研究較少，並且溴化生物標誌物的建立也較少。 Bromotyrosine 加合物在過敏性氣道疾病中升高，並作為嗜酸性粒細胞介導的氧化損傷的特異性標記。

context.en-US: CD36 receptor mediates uptake of oxidized LDL as the principal scavenger receptor on macrophages, delivering oxLDL-derived lipid to form foam cells. This non-downregulated pathway drives cholesterol accumulation in the artery wall. The directionality is receptor to pathological lipid internalization. A caveat is that CD36 also handles fatty acids and other ligands, and other scavenger receptors (SR-A, LOX-1) contribute to oxLDL uptake. CD36 also recognizes oxidized phospholipids on oxLDL and, in combination with TLR signaling, links lipid uptake to sterile inflammation.
context.zh-TW: CD36 receptor 介導 oxidized LDL 作為巨噬細胞上主要清道夫受體的攝取，遞送 oxLDL 衍生的脂質以形成泡沫細胞。這種非下調途徑驅動 cholesterol 在動脈壁積聚。方向性是病理性脂質內化的受體。需要注意的是，CD36 也處理脂肪酸和其他配體，而其他清道夫受體（SR-A、LOX-1）有助於 oxLDL 的攝取。 CD36 也能辨識 oxLDL 上的 oxidized phospholipids，並與 TLR 訊號傳導結合，將脂質攝取與無菌發炎聯繫起來。

context.en-US: CD36 receptor binds thrombospondin-1, and this interaction activates Fyn kinase and p38 MAPK signaling that influences cell adhesion, survival, and inflammation. Thrombospondin-1 thus acts as a CD36 ligand that shapes macrophage behavior. The directionality is ligand binding to intracellular signaling. A caveat is that thrombospondin-1 has many other receptors (e.g., integrins, CD47), so CD36 is one node in a broader network. This signaling can influence macrophage phagocytosis, angiogenesis, and platelet function, expanding CD36's role beyond lipid uptake.
context.zh-TW: CD36 receptor 結合 thrombospondin-1，此交互作用會活化 Fyn 激酶和 p38 MAPK 訊號傳導，進而影響細胞黏附、存活和發炎。因此，Thrombospondin-1 作為塑造巨噬細胞行為的 CD36 配體。方向性是配體與細胞內訊號傳導的結合。需要注意的是，thrombospondin-1 有許多其他受體（例如整合素、CD47），因此 CD36 是更廣泛網路中的節點。這種訊號傳導可以影響巨噬細胞的吞噬作用、血管生成和血小板功能，從而將 CD36 的作用擴展到脂質攝取之外。

context.en-US: CD36 receptor acts as a co-receptor for TLR2/6, enabling recognition of oxidized LDL, amyloid-beta, and microbial products to trigger sterile and innate inflammatory signaling. This bridges lipid sensing to innate immunity. The directionality is co-receptor to inflammasome and NF-kappaB activation. A caveat is that CD36 is not the sole TLR2/6 partner, and its contribution varies by ligand and cell type. This cooperation allows CD36 to bridge lipid sensing and innate immunity, promoting inflammatory responses to oxidized self-ligands.
context.zh-TW: CD36 receptor 作為 TLR2/6 的共同受體，能夠辨識 oxidized LDL、β 澱粉樣蛋白和微生物產物，從而觸發無菌和先天發炎訊號傳導。這將脂質感測與先天免疫聯繫起來。方向性是發炎小體和 NF-κB 活化的共同受體。需要注意的是，CD36 並不是唯一的 TLR2/6 夥伴，其貢獻因配體和細胞類型而異。這種合作使得 CD36 能夠橋接脂質感應和先天免疫，促進對氧化自身配體的發炎反應。

context.en-US: CD36 expression is induced by PPARgamma, which transcriptionally upregulates the receptor in macrophages, creating a feed-forward loop that amplifies oxLDL scavenging. ROS can further enhance this PPARgamma-dependent induction. The directionality is nuclear receptor to receptor upregulation. A caveat is that excessive CD36 induction promotes foam-cell formation, so the loop is maladaptive under chronic lipid stress. The PPARgamma-CD36 axis is also central to adipocyte lipid storage and to foam-cell pathology in atherosclerosis.
context.zh-TW: CD36 expression 是由 PPARgamma 誘導的，PPARgamma 會在轉錄上上調巨噬細胞中的受體，形成一個放大 oxLDL 清除的前饋環。 ROS 可以進一步增強這種 PPARgamma 依賴性誘導。方向性是核受體到受體的上調。需要注意的是，過度的 CD36 誘導會促進泡沫細胞的形成，因此循環在慢性脂質壓力下會出現適應不良。 PPARgamma-CD36 軸對於 atherosclerosis 中的脂肪細胞脂質儲存和泡沫細胞病理學也至關重要。

context.en-US: Cholesterol is oxidized by reactive oxygen species through non-enzymatic chemistry that yields more than 30 oxysterol species. These oxidized products have distinct biological activities compared with native cholesterol. The directionality is ROS to sterol oxidation. A caveat is that many oxysterols are also formed enzymatically by cytochrome P450s, so not all oxysterols indicate oxidative stress. Examples include 7-ketocholesterol and 7beta-hydroxycholesterol, which are cytotoxic and pro-inflammatory and accumulate in atherosclerotic plaques and oxidized LDL.
context.zh-TW: Cholesterol 被 reactive oxygen species 經由非酵素化學氧化，產生 30 多種氧甾醇。這些氧化產物與天然cholesterol相比具有明顯的生物活性。方向性是ROS至甾醇氧化。需要注意的是，許多 oxysterols 也是由細胞色素 P450 酶促形成的，因此並非所有 oxysterols 都表示 oxidative stress。例子包括7-ketocholesterol和7β-羥基cholesterol，它們具有細胞毒性和促炎性，並在atheros硬化斑塊和oxidized LDL中積聚。

context.en-US: Oxysterols regulate LXRalpha as endogenous ligands that activate the nuclear receptor and its target genes controlling cholesterol efflux and transport. This links sterol sensing to reverse cholesterol transport. The directionality is oxysterol to LXRalpha activation. A caveat is that oxysterol structure determines agonist versus antagonist activity at LXR, and some oxysterols also signal through other receptors. LXR activation in turn drives cholesterol efflux and limits inflammation, coupling oxysterol sensing to systemic lipid homeostasis.
context.zh-TW: Oxysterols 將 LXRalpha 視為內源性配體調節，活化核受體及其控制 cholesterol 流出和轉運的目標基因。這將甾醇感測與 reverse cholesterol transport 聯繫起來。方向性是氧固醇對 LXRα 的活化。需要注意的是，氧甾醇結構決定了 LXR 的激動劑與拮抗劑活性，而一些 oxysterols 也透過其他受體發出訊號。 LXR 活化反過來驅動 cholesterol 外流並限制炎症，將氧甾醇感測與全身脂質穩態耦合。

context.en-US: 7-ketocholesterol induces apoptosis through ROS-dependent mitochondrial permeabilization and activation of caspase-3, contributing to death of macrophage foam cells in plaques. As a major oxysterol in oxidized LDL, it is implicated in plaque necrosis. The directionality is oxysterol to programmed cell death. A caveat is that 7-ketocholesterol effects are concentration-dependent and can also trigger inflammatory and autophagic responses before death. Plasma and lesion 7-KC levels correlate with plaque vulnerability, and its toxicity to vascular cells is a recognized contributor to plaque necrosis.
context.zh-TW: 7-ketocholesterol透過ROS依賴性mitochondria1透化和caspase-3的活化誘導apoptosis，導致斑塊中巨噬細胞泡沫細胞死亡。作為 oxidized LDL 中的主要氧甾醇，它與噬菌斑 necrosis 有關。方向性是氧甾醇到程序性細胞死亡。需要注意的是，7-ketocholesterol 的作用具有濃度依賴性，也可能在死亡前引發發炎和自噬反應。血漿和病變 7-KC 水平與斑塊脆弱性相關，其對血管細胞的毒性是斑塊 necQrosis 的公認貢獻者。

context.en-US: PON1 hydrolyzes oxidized phospholipids on HDL, preventing their transfer to LDL and thereby protecting against lipoprotein oxidation. This paraoxonase activity is a key anti-atherogenic function of HDL. The directionality is enzyme to lipid-peroxide detoxification. A caveat is that PON1 activity is highly polymorphic in humans and is also reduced by oxidative stress, creating a variable defensive capacity. PON1 also hydrolyzes lactones and specific organophosphates, and its activity is used as an index of HDL antioxidant capacity.
context.zh-TW: PON1 水解 HDL 上的 oxidized phospholipids，防止轉移為 LDL，從而防止脂蛋白氧化。這種對氧磷酶活性是 HDL 的關鍵抗動脈粥狀硬化功能。方向性是酵素到脂質過氧化物解毒。需要注意的是，PON1 活性在人類中具有高度多態性，並且也會被 oxidative stress 降低，從而產生可變的防禦能力。 PON1也能水解內酯和特定的有機磷酸酯，其活性被用作HDL抗氧化能力的指標。

subject: ROS

context.en-US: ROS trigger NLRP3 inflammasome assembly by promoting the conformational changes and ASC speck formation needed for caspase-1 activation. Mitochondrial ROS and oxidized mitochondrial DNA are particularly implicated as upstream signals. The directionality is oxidant to inflammasome activation. A caveat is that NLRP3 is also activated by non-ROS stimuli (ATP, nigericin, crystals), so ROS is a common but not exclusive trigger. ROS derived from both NOX enzymes and mitochondria converge on NLRP3, linking metabolic and inflammatory stress to IL-1beta production.
context.zh-TW: ROS 透過促進 caspase-1 活化所需的構象變化和 ASC 斑點形成來觸發 NLRP3 inflammasome assembly。 Mitochondrial ROS 和氧化的 mitochondrial DNA 作為上游訊號尤其受到牽連。方向性是發炎小體活化的氧化劑。需要注意的是，NLRP3 也會被非 ROS 刺激（ATP、尼日利亞黴素、晶體）激活，因此 ROS 是一種常見但非排他性的觸發器。源自 NOX 酶的 ROS 和 mitochondria 匯聚於 NLRP3，將代謝和發炎壓力與 IL-1beta 的產生連結起來。
